jobs.title: Software Engineering Director 2 - Corporate Digital Technology
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

U.S. Bank is seeking an accomplished Software Engineering Director
to lead the strategy, execution, and modernization of digital platforms supporting Wealth, Corporate, Commercial, and Institutional Banking (WCIB). This leader will drive innovation, engineering excellence, cloud adoption, and digital transformation while ensuring scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise solutions that enhance the client experience and support business growth. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across a complex organization.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop high-performing software engineering teams responsible for delivering enterprise digital solutions across WCIB platforms.
Define and execute the long-term technology strategy, roadmap, and modernization initiatives aligned with business objectives.
Oversee the design, development, deployment, and support of scalable, secure, and resilient digital applications.
Partner with executive leadership, product teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize investments and technology initiatives.
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices, including Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, cloud-native development, and automation.
Establish engineering standards, architecture governance, and best practices to improve quality, performance, and maintainability.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, risk, security, and data protection requirements across all digital platforms.
Lead large-scale technology transformation initiatives, including cloud migration, platform modernization, and digital innovation programs.
Manage engineering budgets, resource planning, vendor relationships, and technology investments to maximize business value.
Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, talent development, accountability, and operational excellence.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
10 or more years of relevant software engineering experience
Six or more years of experience leading multiple software engineering teams

Required Skills & Qualifications

Executive Leadership experience leading large-scale software engineering organizations and enterprise technology initiatives.
Strong expertise in Digital Transformation, Application Development, and Enterprise Technology Strategy.
Deep knowledge of Cloud Technologies including Azure, AWS, cloud-native architectures, and platform modernization.
Experience with Enterprise Architecture, distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and scalable application design.
Strong understanding of Agile Delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, automation, and modern software engineering practices.
Proven ability to drive Technology Governance, Risk Management, Information Security, and regulatory compliance.
Exceptional Stakeholder Management, executive communication, and cross-functional influence skills.
Experience evaluating technology investments and understanding impacts to revenue, risk, operational efficiency, and customer experience.
Strong people leadership skills with demonstrated success in building teams, coaching leaders, succession planning, and talent development.
Experience within Financial Services, Banking, Wealth Management, Commercial Banking, or Institutional Banking environments preferred.

Location expectations

This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Benefits:

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
Basic term and optional term life insurance
Short-term and long-term disability
Pregnancy disability and parental leave
401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan
Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)
Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities
Adoption assistance
Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

E-Verify

U.S. Bank participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States and certain U.S. territories. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Learn more about the E-Verify program.

The salary range reflects figures based on the primary location, which is listed first. The actual range for the role may differ based on the location of the role. In addition to salary, U.S. Bank offers a comprehensive benefits package, including incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase 401(k) contribution and pension (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Pay Range: $170,255.00 - $200,300.00

U.S. Bank will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment. U.S. Bank conducts background checks consistent with applicable local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act as well as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. U.S. Bank is subject to, and conducts background checks consistent with the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA). In addition, certain positions may also be subject to the requirements of FINRA, NMLS registration, Reg Z, Reg G, OFAC, the NFA, the FCPA, the Bank Secrecy Act, the SAFE Act, and/or federal guidelines applicable to an agreement, such as those related to ethics, safety, or operational procedures.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Join us in our mission to commercialize fusion energy ⚡️

About Type One Energy

Type One Energy Group is mission-driven to provide sustainable, affordable fusion power to the world. Established in 2019 and venture-backed in 2023, the company is led by a team of globally recognized fusion scientists with a strong track record of building state-of-the-art stellarator fusion machines, together with veteran business leaders experienced in scaling companies and commercializing energy technologies.

If you are searching for the best new ideas and share our vision, join us as a Director of Engineering
. This is what you need to know:
Location:
Knoxville, TN
Salary:
Highly Competitive Plus Benefits
Contract:
Permanent, full time
Reporting to:
Senior VP of Engineering

Your role in the mission:

The Director of Engineering is responsible for building, developing, and sustaining a high-performing multidisciplinary engineering organization consisting of more than 100 engineers across Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Systems, CAD/Design, Test, and other technical disciplines.
Reporting directly to the SVP of Engineering, this role serves as the senior leader responsible for organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, leadership development, succession readiness, employee engagement, and engineering capability growth. The Director works closely with engineering functional leaders, technical authorities, and program leadership to ensure the engineering organization is staffed, developed, and structured to meet both current and future business needs.
This position is intentionally focused on organizational leadership rather than technical direction or program execution. Technical priorities, engineering decisions, and project execution are owned by the matrixed engineering functional leadership and program management organizations.
The successful candidate is a strategic organizational leader who combines business acumen, workforce planning expertise, and a passion for developing people. They are comfortable operating in ambiguity, skilled at building alignment across diverse stakeholders, and committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture where individuals can thrive and grow.
Organizational Leadership

Partner with the SVP of Engineering to develop and implement the long-term organizational strategy for Engineering.
Design and continuously improve the organizational structure to support company growth and evolving business needs.
Drive organizational effectiveness initiatives that improve collaboration, communication, and employee engagement.
Establish and promote a positive, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture.
Lead organizational change initiatives and promote adoption of new business and workforce strategies.
Serve as a key member of the Engineering Leadership Team.
Anticipate future workforce and organizational needs in response to changing business priorities and technologies
Influence outcomes across multiple stakeholders without direct authority through strong relationships, credibility, and communication.

Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition

Develop long-range engineering workforce strategies aligned with business growth objectives.
Partner with Human Resources and engineering leadership to forecast staffing requirements.
Support headcount planning and organizational capacity assessments.
Partner with recruiting teams and engineering leaders to support the attraction and retention of highly qualified engineering talent.
Evaluate workforce demographics, skills gaps, and future capability needs.
Develop strategies to support organizational scalability.

Leadership Development

Develop and coach engineering managers and emerging leaders.
Partner with Learning & Development on the implementation of leadership development programs for current and future engineering leaders.
Support the development of high-potential employees and future engineering leaders.
Partner with engineering leadership on talent reviews and succession planning activities.
Ensure continuity planning exists for key leadership and technical positions.
Promote management excellence and consistency across engineering organizations.

Organizational Effectiveness

Promote accountability, coaching, and development across engineering organizations.
Support leaders in conducting effective performance and development discussions.
Monitor organizational performance trends and leadership effectiveness.
Partner with leaders to address organizational and team performance challenges.
Drive initiatives that strengthen employee growth, engagement, and overall organizational effectiveness.

Employee Engagement & Retention

Support initiatives that enhance engagement, morale, and retention.
Partner with HR on the analysis of employee feedback and implement improvement actions.
Foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and professional growth.
Promote employee recognition and career development opportunities.
Promote diversity of thought and inclusive leadership practices.

Career Development & Engineering Capability Growth

Partner and support engineering career frameworks and progression models.
Partner and support the development of technical and leadership development pathways.
Identify organizational competency gaps and partner with appropriate teams to target development initiatives.
Ensure engineering capabilities evolve to support future technology and business objectives.

Organizational Metrics & Analytics

Develop and monitor workforce and organizational metrics to support strategic decision-making and organizational effectiveness.
Utilize workforce data to support strategic decision-making and continuous improvement.

Budget & Resource Stewardship

Support engineering labor planning and workforce budgeting activities.
Manage budgets associated with recruiting, training, leadership development, and employee engagement programs.
Ensure investments are aligned with organizational priorities and workforce strategies.

What you’ll need:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
15+ years of progressive engineering experience.
10+ years of leadership experience managing engineering organizations.
Experience leading managers and senior leaders within multidisciplinary engineering environments.
Demonstrated success leading organizations of 100+ engineers and technical professionals.
Experience supporting multiple engineering disciplines including Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Systems, CAD/Design, or related fields.
Strong leadership, coaching, and organizational development skills.
Experience with workforce planning, organizational development, succession planning, and leadership development within engineering organizations.
Excellent communication and executive leadership skills.
Proven ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and establish clarity, priorities, and direction.
Strong relationship-building and influencing skills with the ability to drive results across matrixed organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, Organizational Leadership, or Business Administration.
Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, energy, industrial systems, robotics, or similarly complex product development environments.
Experience supporting engineering organizations during periods of significant growth.
Formal training or certification in organizational development, leadership coaching, change management, or talent management.

We offer
:
In addition to a basic salary and yearly bonus, you will also get…
A hybrid work policy
Stock options
Relocation allowance
Insurance plans
Retirement options
And many more great voluntary benefits

Type One Energy applies proven advanced manufacturing methods, modern computational physics and high-field superconducting magnets to develop its optimized stellarator fusion energy system. Our FusionDirect development program pursues the lowest-risk, shortest-schedule path to a fusion power plant over the coming decade, using a partner-intensive and capital-efficient strategy.
Type One Energy is committed to community engagement in the development and deployment of its clean energy technology. For more information, visit www.typeoneenergy.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

Director

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Renewable Energy Semiconductor Manufacturing

jobs.title: Technical Director, Traffic Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Technical Director, Traffic Engineering
to join our team in New York. This role can be based in any of the following NY offices: Valhalla, NYC, Buffalo, or Troy
.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Traffic Engineer who is innovative, results-oriented, and team-focused. The right candidate would be joining a tight-knit team of traffic engineers and transportation planners who value technical excellence, career development, pride in our work, a collaborative team environment, and a passion for finding the right solutions that enhance mobility and safety. The Technical Director, Traffic Engineering will bring and leadership skills to help grow our business, oversee project delivery and staff development, and provide technical assistance and guidance in engineering and design for our local, state, and regional clients. Our ideal candidate has a proven track record of successfully delivering projects from initiation through operations and maintenance, with a strong focus on client satisfaction and technical excellence. This position will primarily support projects in New York. .Some project-related travel may be required.

Your Impact

Support the delivery and execution of project scope, objectives, and requirements, ensuring close collaboration and alignment with clients and stakeholders. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues. Ensure project deliverables meet high-quality standards and specified requirements. Implement rigorous quality review processes, manage version controls, and track comments and resolutions. Prepare and present comprehensive project progress statuses using reporting tools and dashboards. Monitor and meet defined performance metrics, tracking budget, time, scope, and communication details to ensure projects meet schedule and client expectations.
Stay current with emerging technologies, industry best practices, and relevant standards .
Lead and direct multi-disciplinary project teams, including internal staff, sub-consultants, contractors, and vendors. Foster a culture of trust, transparency, and accountability.
Manage internal groups or outside vendors to identify, plan, negotiating contracts, deliver and monitoring performance to client specifications.
Coordinate with various internal and external partners, including cross-discipline and functional teams, government agencies (i.e., DOTs), and other stakeholders.
Comfortably present complex technical and project information to diverse audiences, including executives, client teams, and public forums.
Contribute to and potentially lead the development of technical proposals, scopes of work, and budgeting for projected work.
Assist in building and growing the firm's Traffic Engineering, Safety and Intelligent Transportation Systems practice across New York State.
Foster technical development and mentoring of staff.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Traffic Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Technology, preferred, or equivalent years of experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in traffic, ITS, & safety planning, analysis, and design.
Licensed Professional Engineer in the State of New York, or another state and able to obtain reciprocity in New York State within 6 months of hire. PTOE certification (highly preferred).
Proven experience managing complex projects with budgets, schedules, and technical requirements.
Proven experience with NYSDOT, MTA, and other regional agencies.
Develop new project opportunities, manage client relationships, and prepare and manage proposal submissions
Strong leadership, mentoring, and team-building skills.
Exceptional communication abilities including written, verbal, and public speaking.
Demonstrated success in proposal writing, client presentations, and strategic project delivery.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment.
Passion for innovation, quality, and financial performance
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet business needs.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Engineering.
Active engagement in relevant industry organizations.
Project experience - Traffic operations and safety, ATSPM, signal design, signal timing, NYSDOT experience, Interstate Reconstruction, Environmental Impact Statements.
Expertise in traffic engineering principles, practices, NYSDOT project delivery process, Traffic Signal Design, Signage, pavement markings, Maco, Meso and Micro-simulation modeling.

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

Compensation:

Expected Salary (all locations): $139,800 - $249,150

WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and may offer additional benefits and compensation, depending on circumstances and the type of work being performed not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law.

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering, Climbing Robotics for Critical Infrastructure

We are working with a well funded, early stage robotics company building a genuinely new category of climbing robot for critical infrastructure, including electrical transmission networks, pipelines, bridges, industrial tanks, shipbuilding, renewable energy assets and data centers. Rather than drones or conventional inspection methods, the platform uses proprietary magnetic locomotion to climb steel structures and physically interact with them, with a long term roadmap extending into contact measurement, corrosion analysis, grinding, welding preparation and bolt torque verification.

The company is on its third to fourth generation of robot development and is solving problems that simply do not have off the shelf answers yet, particularly around magnetic adhesion and actuator design. Strong customer interest already exists across the US, Canada and Europe, and the business is well capitalized heading into a significant funding round later this year, with no concerns around future fundraising.
About the role

This is a true player coach position, roughly 80 percent hands on engineering leadership and execution, 20 percent strategic planning. You will be the company's first true engineering leadership hire, working closely with the founders to introduce engineering process, structure and operational discipline while keeping the pace and culture that has gotten the company this far. You will not be inheriting a mature engineering organization, you will be helping build one, including laying the foundations needed for rapid growth after the upcoming raise. The title today is Head of Engineering, with a clear intention to promote into a VP Engineering position as the company scales rather than hiring externally for that seat.

What we are looking for

Robotics industry experience, ideally within legged robotics, field robotics or other complex autonomous systems. Strong systems engineering experience with testing and validation as a genuine part of your background. Experience building engineering organizations inside early stage startups, including introducing process and structure rather than inheriting it. Around five years of engineering leadership experience, including managing small engineering teams and, where possible, managers. Strong technical credibility across robotics software, C++, ROS2 and simulation or modeling tools. Experience balancing customer needs with engineering priorities during rapid product development. A genuine appreciation for robotics operating in harsh outdoor environments where reliability is critical.

What will make you successful here is calm, experienced leadership, comfort working in ambiguity, a willingness to build process from scratch, being a strong communicator who asks good questions rather than chasing every new idea, staying pragmatic and execution focused, being comfortable changing direction when needed, using AI as a genuine engineering productivity tool, and being more motivated by building meaningful technology than by maximizing salary. Low ego and collaborative colleagues who are enjoyable to work with matter a great deal here.

Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager in Broker Dealer, you'll help balance on-time delivery of new features alongside system stability and scale, all while helping mentor and grow a team of talented engineers. Broker Dealer is the core of the Betterment platform. On a busy day, we securely move millions of dollars through the Betterment system and ensure each transaction flows through a complex series of risk checks for strict regulatory compliance. Every ounce of efficiency and intelligence we pour into this system translates into more value for our customers.

We’re looking for an Engineering leader to contribute to answering our most difficult backend scaling, software design, and optimization questions. This role will be overseeing a team of individual contributors, and will work closely with other engineering managers in Broker Dealer. While we don’t expect you to code on a daily basis, we do expect you to quickly familiarize yourself with the tech stack, codebase and specific business domains so that you can better support the team’s mission and deliver meaningful business impact.

This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.

New York City: $210,000-245,000

This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus.

A Day In The Life

Manage a team of 6-8 backend engineers who build innovative trading technology that powers our investing products.
Foster career development and align roadmap opportunities with each engineer’s growth interests, keeping them technically engaged.
Cultivate a team culture that values agility, accountability, constructive feedback, and celebrates successes.
Be a hands-on technical mentor by regularly diving into the codebase, participating in code reviews, partnering with stakeholders to shape solutions, and driving effective technical decision-making.
Champion maintainability and reliability by advocating for the long-term stability of the technology your team builds.
Balance the need for speed of delivery with the importance of correctness and quality in every project your team undertakes.
Continuously refine team processes and practices to deliver high-impact, high-quality outcomes for the business and ensure the appropriately engineered solutions.
Develop deep domain and industry knowledge to be a highly effective partner across internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal and Compliance teams to ensure we consistently deliver the right sized solutions to the right problems.

What We're Looking For

3+ years of experience in formal Engineering Management of direct reports.
8+ years of experience in building and maintaining backend distributed systems using Java or a similar strongly typed programming language.
Experience managing, mentoring, and inspiring talented engineers, guiding them toward excellence in both professional growth and project outcomes.
A proven track record to rapidly close knowledge gaps, enhancing productivity and establishing trust within the organization.
A history of fostering accountability and ownership, motivating teams to take initiative and consistently deliver right sized solutions.
Experience cultivating high-performing teams that focus on speed of execution and the rigor to maintain quality.
Ability to adjust leadership style to meet the evolving needs of the team and the business.
Effective collaborator capable of working with other engineering teams, product managers, subject matter experts, non-technical stakeholders and third party vendors to build and ship high quality software.
Ability to translate business strategy into Engineering initiatives that drive delivery of meaningful outcomes.

Join a team built on these core values

We change lives

Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease .

We set audacious goals

We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.

We value all perspectives

When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.

We simplify financial services

We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.

Our Commitment To Your Total Well-being

We offer a competitive suite of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options
Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.

This role exists to modernize the Health System out of a legacy, capital-intensive, on-premises operating model and into a resilient, consumption-based infrastructure that can be recovered in hours rather than weeks. jobs.description:
TJX Companies

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description

Industrial Engineering Senior Manager

The Senior Manager of Store Engineering leads a team of Field Engineers responsible for identifying, developing, and implementing strategies that improve productivity, optimize labor standards, increase operational capacity, simplify associate workloads, and enhance store processes while maintaining safe and efficient store operations.

This role partners closely with field leadership and Home Office Store Engineering to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and drive operational excellence. Success in this position requires strong leadership, communication, influence, and collaboration skills to deliver sustainable business results across the store organization.

Major Areas of Responsibility

Leadership & Field Engineering Support

Lead and develop a team of Field Engineers, providing direction, coaching, and support to ensure successful execution of engineering initiatives.
Oversee field engineering activities, including operational assessments, audits, pilot testing, implementation support, and continuous improvement efforts.
Partner with field leadership to gather operational insights, identify opportunities, and develop solutions that improve store performance.
Lead complex implementations and operational improvement projects while ensuring consistency with enterprise standards and objectives.
Promote and apply Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies to drive process efficiencies and operational excellence.

Store Operations & Workforce Optimization

Design, analyze, develop, and implement solutions that improve store operations in areas including:
Backroom and office area layouts
Material handling processes and equipment
Best methods and motion economy
Service desk, front-end, and other support area layouts
Workforce management, staffing, and scheduling practices
Markdown execution processes and supporting tools or equipment

Develop, implement, and maintain engineering standards that support:
Staffing and scheduling analysis
Forecasted labor models
Labor allocation and optimization
Workforce management effectiveness
Return on investment (ROI) analysis

Process Improvement & Strategic Analysis

Analyze and recommend process improvements that optimize the Vendor-to-Distribution Center-to-Store supply chain network.
Identify opportunities to improve productivity, increase capacity, reduce workload complexity, and enhance overall operational effectiveness.
Evaluate current processes and recommend solutions that drive efficiency while maintaining service, safety, and execution standards.
Continuously review operational performance and develop engineering solutions that:
Minimize cycle time
Eliminate redundant activities
Improve labor productivity
Optimize workflow efficiency
Determine the most effective location and timing for floor-ready activities
Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Who We Are Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Industrial Engineering, Finance, Business Operations, Retail Operations, or a related discipline.
Prior experience leading teams in a dynamic, fast paced environment with a focus on associate training and development.
Demonstrated experience leading projects, influencing stakeholders, and implementing operational improvements.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build partnerships across multiple levels of the organization.
Strong understanding of business and operational processes and procedures.

Lean Six Sigma certification or demonstrated continuous improvement experience.
Experience with labor standards, workforce management, capacity planning, or operational engineering.

Delivering and curating multiple complex portfolios that fundamentally transform core business operations within a mission-critical operational framework

Being a positive force elevating IT from order-taker to partner across all stakeholder groups
Understanding and leading the role emerging technologies (such as AI) should play in delivering solutions, increasing operational efficiency, and improving Republic’s ability to turn data into insights and insights into action
Controlling cost and maximizing value realized on our investment portfolio
Improving delivery, operation and adoption of custom / purpose-built applications and solutions produced and integrated by the team
Further evolving the organization’s ability to support business growth and technology evolution

Articulate decision drivers and constraints across stakeholder groups
Translate technical risk, delivery tradeoffs, and operational impact into clear recommendations for senior leaders

Facilitate communication within and across all stakeholders

Direct resources and financial investment to improve the stability and performance of systems
Partner with business leaders to address challenges with cost and efficiency
Infuse milestone and progress-centric execution focus across the organization

Understand business context, frameworks, and processes critical to delivery of services and organizational success measures

Manage application development resources to maximize business value

Partner with other stakeholders on vendor and contract management, build-versus-buy decisions, software licensing, capitalization, and accountability for total cost of ownership

Support a culture that attracts and retains outstanding talent with a passion for the aviation industry and Republic Airways, including through community engagement and leadership
Bring passion for coaching and developing individual contributors and managers
Recognize talent and create an environment that fosters psychological safety, accountability, and continuous learning
Grow engineering and automation depth and capability at the individual and organizational level
Set challenging goals and provide the coaching and training required to achieve them
Create an environment of accountability and ownership, where employees understand what is expected of them and own the results they produce

EDUCATION And/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered
5+ years as enterprise-wide and critical platform IT leader, responsible for operational performance of critical systems
5+ years in IT leadership, delivering transformational changes within regulated environments (aviation, transportation, shipping/delivery, etc.)
5+ years in roles as an upline manager of managers, with experience developing individuals into roles with increased span
Hands-on technical experience with previous roles in architecture, software engineering, platform team leadership, QA leadership, data/BI development, or similar.
Direct experience with enterprise stakeholder roadmap planning, relationship development, and alignment

PREFERRED EDUCATION And/or EXPERIENCE

Experience with cloud platforms, data/BI platforms, integration architecture, software engineering, DevOps practices, QA, automation, vendor management, and enterprise architecture (TOGAF or similar)
Successful use of AI and related technologies (generative and agentic AI, RPA, machine learning) to improve operational efficiency delivery of IT solutions and/or business operations
Experience with continuous improvement tools/methods
Work with ITIL or similar frameworks to leverage principles as appropriate

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret the most complex documents. Ability to respond effectively to the most sensitive inquiries or situations. Polished executive presence with an ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences.

REASONING/PROBLEM SOLVING ABILITY

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk and hear.
Able to focus with clear vision at 20 inches or less (computer screen) and identify and distinguish colors (color vision).

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, New York, Lisbon, London

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Director to lead a team of engineers within our Security Products Engineering group. This role will have a strong focus on delivering effective and reliable cybersecurity products and systems. This includes strategy, leadership, technical guidance and building engineering teams. The ideal candidate will have a deep technical background, proven leadership experience, and a passion for developing people and cultivating a strong engineering culture.

This role reports to the VP of Engineering for Security Products and is expected to work with peers to drive results and improvement in alignment with the group’s strategy.

Who you are

A qualified candidate will be equally skilled with people and technology, able to organize and inspire others while participating in technical discussions and planning.

Experience managing engineering managers.
Experience managing complex projects with external dependencies
Results and metrics driven
A strong attention to detail
Great communication skills
Experience hiring great engineers
A kind and generous attitude towards customers and coworkers alike
Ability to set technical direction and own decisions

What you’ll do

Lead multiple teams of engineers delivering customer facing products.
Partner with Product Management to define and execute a strategy and achieve audacious goals.
Lead and mentor engineering managers and engineers across the organization.
Work with peers around the world to drive cross organizational projects and develop best practices.
Foster a culture that is results oriented without sacrificing curiosity, kindness, and empathy for customers and co-workers alike.
Define metrics that guide the engineering teams.
Drive continuous improvement in your teams

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Austin based hires: Estimated annual salary of $300,000 - $380,000
For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $330,000 - $415,000
For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €145,000 - €180,000
For London based hires: Estimated annual salary of £200,000 - £250,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

Medical/Rx Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
Commuter Spending Accounts
Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
Life & Accident Insurance
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Company Description
Macha PSM provides specialized process safety consulting and engineering services to a wide range of facilities and industries. The team supports clients from small cold storage operations to some of the largest global corporations, offering both consulting and full engineering capabilities. Services include developing innovative PSM programs, leading Compliance Audits and Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs), and supporting EPA and OSHA inspections. The engineering team delivers advanced technical work such as P&ID development, relief vent analysis, inventory calculations, ventilation assessment, and material and energy balance calculations. With offices in Huntsville, Alabama and Moscow, Idaho, Macha PSM is focused on delivering tailored, high-quality solutions to meet the unique safety and engineering needs of each client.
Role Description
The Director of Engineering is a full-time, on-site role based in Huntsville, AL, responsible for leading the engineering organization and ensuring high-quality technical delivery across all projects. This role oversees engineering strategy, resource planning, and project execution, aligning engineering priorities with business and client needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include guiding engineering teams, reviewing and approving technical designs and analyses, and coordinating with project managers and consultants to meet deadlines and quality standards. The Director of Engineering will collaborate with leadership to improve processes, implement best practices, and support integration between software, engineering tools, and process safety methodologies. This role also involves mentoring engineers, supporting recruitment, and fostering a culture of safety, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Qualifications

Professional Engineer license or the ability to obtain a license.
Experience designing ammonia refrigeration systems.
Familiarity with process safety information development (P&IDs, relief system design, material and energy balance, inventory calculations, etc.).
Demonstrated strength in Engineering Management, including overseeing multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Proven Team Leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers, building high-performing teams, and fostering collaboration and accountability.
Background in Software Development or working closely with software teams to support engineering tools, automation, and integration with process safety systems.
Solid Project Management experience, including planning, budgeting, risk management, and delivering engineering work on time and within scope.
Experience with Integration of engineering systems, data, and workflows to streamline operations and improve reliability and insight.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, or related discipline) or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in process safety, industrial facilities, or regulated environments (e.g., EPA, OSHA) is highly beneficial.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex engineering topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work on-site in Huntsville, AL and collaborate effectively across multiple offices and client locations.

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Our Team

Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

About The Role

Our team is passionate, talented, and deeply customer-focused. We build the platform that thousands of early education programs rely on every day to run their business, serve families, and support children’s growth. As a vertical SaaS company, brightwheel already sits in the middle of all the key workflows in early education: enrollment, billing, staffing, classroom planning, and family communication. We are now extending that foundation into a system of action – where software not only records what happened, but also anticipates work, recommends next steps, and takes safe, automated action on behalf of school leaders, teachers, families, and our internal teams.

We’re looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager who combines strong people leadership, technical judgment, and ownership of measurable outcomes.

In this role, you will lead a team building AI-powered systems for brightwheel’s go-to-market organization. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role: you’ll lead discovery, prototype workflows, and validate them with internal users rather than wait for perfectly defined requirements or dedicated Product and Design support. You’ll work directly with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, and Data to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable products and workflows. The work spans internal products, Salesforce and data integrations, evaluation systems, and customer-facing automation. You’ll use metrics to decide where to invest, stay close enough to architecture and implementation to form an independent view, and step into prototypes or critical-path code when it helps the team move faster.

What You’ll Do

Lead a full-stack engineering team from problem definition through production, measurement, and iteration.
Translate company goals into clear outcomes, investment choices, and a credible execution plan.
Set the engineering strategy for quality, reliability, security, privacy, and operational health.
Ship AI-powered products and change how the team works with AI—not just add AI features.
Hire and develop strong engineers, set a clear bar, and act when the team or an individual is below it.
Make capacity, dependencies, forecasts, and risks visible early.
Work directly with GTM and Operations leaders to identify the real problem, map the workflow, prototype a usable solution, and define how success will be measured before scaling.
Build internal products and AI workflows that improve revenue, conversion, productivity, or quality; measure adoption and results.
Own cross-system execution across Salesforce, data, product, and AI services, with clear dependencies and decision rights.

You may be a good fit if you

Have led an engineering team that delivered measurable customer or business results.
Have the technical depth to challenge architecture, product, data, reliability, and operational decisions without taking the work away from the team.
Have set engineering strategy and made explicit investment and prioritization choices.
Have shipped an AI-powered product or workflow to production and can explain the measurable result.
Have hired and developed strong engineers, built succession, and handled performance issues directly.
Have built trusted partnerships across Product, Design, and business teams while representing a clear Engineering point of view.

Experience in vertical SaaS, education, fintech, healthcare, CRM, ecommerce, or another operations-heavy domain.
Led a material change in product direction, architecture, or operating model.
Built production AI products, agents, evaluation systems, or automation.
Experience leading engineering for internal business functions and working directly with senior stakeholders.
Strong product intuition and UX empathy; can represent Product and Design for small bets and fast iterations when dedicated support is limited.
Experience connecting CRM, data, integration, and AI systems into reliable workflows that move a business metric.

Data and systems: PostgreSQL, Redshift, DynamoDB, Airflow, Salesforce, and service integrations.
Cloud: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability.

Scope of the Broadcast Signal Chain

The role owns the complete broadcast signal chain—from studio cameras, lighting, audio, graphics, production control and master control through satellite, fiber/IP, full-power and low-power television affiliates, OTT platforms and digital streaming endpoints.
The Director leads the Broadcast Engineering team and is accountable for broadcast uptime, audio and video quality, FCC compliance, transmission reliability, disaster recovery, cybersecurity coordination, capital planning, preventive maintenance, vendor management and technology modernization.

Scope of Leadership

Manages a team of Broadcast Engineers (II, III, and possibly Chief Engineer/Lead roles), including hiring, scheduling, performance management, and on-call rotation oversight
Owns capital planning and budget for broadcast infrastructure (cameras, switchers, servers, RF/satellite systems, IT convergence hardware)
Acts as the primary liaison between engineering and production, programming, IT, and executive leadership
Ultimate accountable owner for FCC compliance, uptime, and disaster recovery/business continuity planning
Sets the technology roadmap (e.g., IP-based video migration, cloud playout, automation systems, cybersecurity for broadcast networks)

Live Commerce & Product Presentation

Because Shop LC is a live commerce organization, the Director is also responsible for ensuring that broadcast technology supports the accurate and compelling presentation of jewelry, gemstones, fashion, beauty and home products. This includes camera quality, close-up product imaging, gemstone and metal color accuracy, lighting, audio clarity, graphics integrity, and reliable delivery of the Shop LC signal to customers across every television and digital distribution platform.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic planning: Long-term technology upgrades, vendor/contract negotiation, capital expenditure justification
Team leadership: Hiring, training, mentoring, succession planning for engineering staff
Operational oversight: Ensuring 24/7 broadcast reliability, managing outage escalation and root-cause response
Compliance & risk: FCC regulatory adherence, safety programs (RF exposure, tower/ladder safety, electrical hazards), business continuity/disaster recovery
Cross-functional partnership: Partnering closely with Production, Sales, Merchandising, Programming, Ecommerce, IT, Facilities, Finance and executive leadership to translate technical constraints/capabilities and ensure broadcast infrastructure remains reliable, scalable, secure and capable of supporting future television, streaming and live-commerce growth
Vendor & contract management: Managing relationships with equipment manufacturers, satellite/uplink providers, system integrators
Service levels & monitoring: Establishing measurable service levels, monitoring, escalation procedures and redundancy standards, and maintaining disaster-recovery plans for all mission-critical broadcast systems
Incident response: Leading root-cause analysis and corrective action following significant technical incidents

Qualifications

Experience

Typically 10+ years in broadcast/media engineering, with at least 3–5 years in a supervisory or management capacity
Track record managing teams responsible for live production, master control, or transmission systems
Experience with capital budgeting and vendor negotiation

Technical Depth

Deep knowledge of broadcast systems: RF/satellite, video servers, switching/routing, IP-based workflows, studio automation
Familiarity with IT infrastructure as it intersects with broadcast (networking, cybersecurity, virtualization)
Understanding of FCC regulations and compliance requirements

Certifications (preferred, not always required)

SBE certifications at a senior level (CBRE, CBNT, or similar)
FCC General Radiotelephone Operator License (GROL)
Project management credential (PMP) is a plus given the budget/roadmap responsibilities

Education

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Broadcast Technology, or related field is preferred; equivalent hands-on experience with progressive leadership responsibility is often accepted in lieu of a degree

Leadership / Soft Skills

Proven people management (hiring, coaching, performance reviews, scheduling a 24/7 team)
Strong communication skills for translating technical issues to non-technical executives
Budget ownership and vendor negotiation experience
Change management skills, especially around technology transitions (e.g., SDI to IP)

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Deployment
jobs.description:
Who we are

Video is 90% of the world's data. Most of it is invisible to machines.

TwelveLabs builds the intelligence layer to change that. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government.

We have raised more than $210 million from NEA, Radical Ventures, Amazon, NVIDIA, Snowflake, Databricks, Index Ventures, NAVER Ventures, Korea Investment Partners, Quadrille Capital, Red Bull Ventures, and AI pioneers including Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, and Alexandr Wang.

We are a global company, headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seoul, New York, and London, and employees around the world. We believe the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences make our products stronger. Building technology that understands the world in all its complexity requires people who see it from every angle. We are looking for individuals who are driven by hard problems and want their work to matter. Come build it with us!

About The Role

With our Series B, we are entering our next chapter: building a full-stack video AI company with frontier models at the foundation, an enterprise platform in the middle, and agentic systems that turn raw video into actionable knowledge and insights.

Our customers include some of the world’s leading companies across media, sports, advertising, security, and the public sector. They are asking us to solve increasingly complex problems—not only through our APIs, but by deploying TwelveLabs technology securely and reliably into their environments.

As Director of Engineering, Deployment & Integrations, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for deploying TwelveLabs technology into our customers' and partners’ environments and integrating it deeply into their existing technology ecosystems.

You will own the engineering strategy and execution for customer and distribution partner deployments across hyperscalers, private cloud, on-premise, and other complex enterprise environments. You will work closely with our Engineering and Go to Market teams to turn complex customer requirements into scalable, repeatable deployment and integration capabilities.

This is a highly cross-functional and customer-facing engineering leadership role. You will be equally comfortable working through architecture with a customer's technical team, diving into a complex deployment or integration challenge, and building the systems and processes that allow the next customer to move faster.

Your goal is to make TwelveLabs easy to deploy, easy to integrate, and reliable to operate — while turning the lessons from each customer into capabilities that scale across the business.

In this role, you will focus on the core competencies listed below

Customer Deployment

Own the engineering lifecycle for customer and partner deployments, from technical discovery and architecture through implementation, production launch, and ongoing operations.
Lead deployments across public cloud, customer VPCs, private cloud, on-premise infrastructure, and other customer-controlled environments.
Partner directly with strategic customers, partners and their engineering, infrastructure, security, and IT teams to solve complex deployment challenges.
Establish the technical standards, tooling, and playbooks required to make deployments predictable and repeatable.
Turn recurring customer deployment requirements into scalable product and platform capabilities wherever possible.

Integrations & Enterprise Architecture

Own the engineering strategy for integrating TwelveLabs into customers' existing technology ecosystems.
Build scalable integration patterns across enterprise applications, data platforms, storage systems, identity and access management, APIs, and AI/ML infrastructure.
Partner with Product and Engineering to translate recurring customer integration requirements into reusable platform capabilities.
Establish standards and tooling that make integrations faster, more reliable, and increasingly self-service.
Balance customer-specific requirements with a long-term architecture that prevents TwelveLabs from accumulating one-off integrations.
Help define the technical architecture and interfaces that allow TwelveLabs to become deeply embedded in customer workflows and applications.

Deployment Automation & Developer Experience

Build the tooling, automation, and internal platforms that allow engineering teams to provision, configure, upgrade, integrate, and operate customer environments efficiently.
Develop deployment and integration architectures that move TwelveLabs from bespoke implementations toward repeatable, highly automated capabilities.
Establish strong CI/CD, release management, configuration management, and observability practices for distributed customer environments.
Create an exceptional internal developer experience for engineers responsible for building and supporting deployments and integrations.

Product & Engineering Partnership

Work closely with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure deployment and integration requirements are incorporated into product architecture from the beginning.
Identify recurring friction across customer deployments and integrations and turn those insights into product and platform improvements.
Partner with Research and ML teams to understand the operational requirements of serving increasingly capable multimodal models in production environments.
Help define the technical roadmap for deployment and integration infrastructure as TwelveLabs expands its product portfolio and customer footprint.

Customer, Partnerships & Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as a senior technical partner to Solutions Engineering, Sales, and Product on the most complex customer opportunities.
Translate customer requirements into clear technical decisions, engineering priorities, and execution plans.
Establish a strong operating rhythm across customer-facing and engineering teams to ensure deployments and integrations move quickly without compromising quality.
Communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly to both highly technical audiences and executive stakeholders.

Security, Compliance & Trust

Build deployment and integration architectures suitable for enterprise and public sector customers with demanding security and compliance requirements.
Partner with Security and Infrastructure teams to support requirements around data isolation, identity, access control, encryption, auditability, and compliance.
Help establish deployment patterns capable of supporting increasingly regulated and security-sensitive environments.

Team Building & Culture

Build and lead a world-class Deployment & Integrations Engineering organization.
Recruit, develop, and retain engineers who thrive at the intersection of distributed systems, infrastructure, product engineering, enterprise integrations, and customer problem-solving.
Create a culture of high ownership, technical excellence, urgency, and disciplined execution.
Establish the processes and operating mechanisms that allow the team to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for reliability and customer experience.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

10+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure, platform engineering, or distributed systems, with significant experience leading globally distributed engineering teams.
Experience leading engineering organizations responsible for deploying complex software, AI/ML systems, or infrastructure into enterprise customer environments.
Deep technical understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, networking, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, infrastructure-as-code, and automated deployment systems.
Experience deploying software across multiple cloud environments and/or customer-controlled infrastructure, including air-gapped, disconnected, regulated, or highly secure environments
Hands-on experience owning the software deployment lifecycle end-to-end — versioning, release management, rollout + rollback strategy, upgrade paths, and post-deployment operations across distributed customer environments.
Deep experience with software packaging patterns for shipping into customer-controlled environments — container images, Helm charts, operator patterns, installer + bootstrap flows, air-gapped bundles, and dependency + configuration management.
A track record of turning bespoke customer implementations into scalable, repeatable engineering systems.
Strong customer-facing instincts and the ability to operate credibly with senior engineers, architects, security teams, and technical executives at large enterprises.
A bias toward action and a willingness to get into the technical details when the situation demands it.
Excellent judgment about when to build a one-off solution for a strategic customer versus investing in a scalable platform capability.
Experience operating in a high-growth startup where product requirements and customer needs evolve rapidly.
Experience working with globally distributed teams

Strong Candidates May Also Have

Experience deploying AI/ML or GPU-intensive workloads into customer environments.
Experience with public sector, defense, financial services, or other highly regulated customers.
Experience taking an enterprise deployment motion from bespoke implementations to a standardized platform.
Experience building or leading Solutions Engineering, Field Engineering, Deployment Engineering, or Professional Services Engineering organizations.

We are a global company that values the uniqueness of each person’s journey. The differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences are what allow us to challenge the status quo. We’re looking for people motivated by our mission and ready to help build the company that defines how the world understands video.

Benefits and Perks

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment

🚀 Work closely with a collaborative, mission-driven team on cutting-edge AI technology

We don’t simply hire exceptional talent; we cultivate it
, creating meaningful career pathways for veterans, military spouses, and professionals who share our passion for advancing technology and strengthening the missions we serve.

Position Overview
SteerBridge Strategies is seeking a Deputy Chief Technology Officer (DCTO), Infrastructure to own the cloud architecture, security compliance, corporate network, and IT foundation that underpin SteerBridge's federal technology portfolio. This role sits at the center of the company's technical operations, providing the secure, scalable, and compliant infrastructure that SteerBridge's mission programs, including VA disability claims modernization, aviation readiness analytics, and federal fintech platforms, are built on, as well as the internal IT and security posture of the company itself.

Security Compliance & Risk Management: Own the security compliance posture of SteerBridge's infrastructure, including RMF/ATO packages, continuous monitoring, and remediation of findings across all programs and corporate systems.

Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a credible representative of SteerBridge's technical posture to government authorizing officials, auditors, and executive leadership, translating infrastructure and security decisions into mission and business risk terms.
Governance & Standards: Chair or participate in Architecture Review Boards and the Technical Risk Committee, ensuring infrastructure and security decisions across AICES, AIRES, SteerFi, and corporate IT remain aligned and auditable.
Program & People Leadership: Guide and mentor infrastructure, network, and security engineers; build career pathing and technical growth plans in partnership with SteerBridge's Career Ladder framework.

At Goodwin, we work with some of the world’s most successful and innovative investors, entrepreneurs and disruptors in the life sciences, private equity, real estate, technology and financial industries, and where they converge. The Director of Engineering will provide strategic and operational leadership to a high-performing team of engineers and full-stack developers. This role is responsible for driving the technical vision, architectural integrity, and execution of scalable, secure, and production-grade AI-enabled systems. As a key engineering leader, you will bridge the gap between complex business strategy and robust technical execution, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.

What You Will Do

Provide direct, empathetic, and growth-oriented leadership to an expanding engineering organization. Attract, mentor, and retain top-tier talent while fostering a high-accountability, inclusive, and collaborative team culture.
Define the technical roadmap, engineering standards, and architectural blueprints for AI-enabled systems and backend services. Ensure all solutions are scalable, maintainable, resilient, and seamlessly aligned with enterprise architecture.
Oversee the lifecycle design, rapid development, and production deployment of AI-driven applications and full-stack services, ensuring robust integration between modern AI frameworks and core backend infrastructure. Champion rigorous development practices—including advanced CI/CD pipelines, robust automated testing, thorough code reviews, and comprehensive operational readiness—to guarantee the highest standards of code quality and system reliability.
Establish, track, and optimize key engineering metrics (e.g., DORA metrics, system latency, model inference performance, and infrastructure cost efficiency) to drive continuous operational improvement
Supervise agile resource allocation, sprint prioritization, and capacity planning across multiple cross-functional initiatives to balance velocity with engineering health.
Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure all AI system deployments adhere to stringent corporate policies, security protocols, data privacy standards, and evolving regulatory requirements.
Act as a strategic liaison between engineering, product management, and business stakeholders to translate organizational vision into executable technical roadmaps.
Drive internal innovation by spearheading engineering guilds or communities of practice focused on emerging AI paradigms, agentic workflows, and modern backend architectures.
Partner with recruiting to build a highly competitive hiring pipeline, design technical evaluation frameworks, and lead onboarding strategies for incoming engineering talent.

Who You Are

Deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI system architectures, LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector databases, secure API design, and distributed full-stack application development.
A tracking record of scaling engineering teams and developing technical leaders (Managers and Principal/Staff Engineers) within fast-paced environments.
Exceptional ability to translate ambiguous, high-level business requirements into structured, phased, and executable engineering sprints.
Outstanding communication skills, with the proven ability to articulate complex technical architectures to non-technical executive stakeholders and align diverse teams toward a unified technical vision.
Typically requires a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, alongside 8+ years of progressive engineering experience, with 3+ years in a dedicated engineering management or leadership capacity.
Occasional travel.

At Goodwin, you will discover your next career opportunity with a rewarding compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including:

Health, dental, and vision insurance
Life and disability insurance
Retirement & Savings Plan
Emergency back-up child and adult care
Paid vacation, sick time off, and holidays
Professional development and career advancement opportunities
Employee recognition and reward programs
Employee wellness and assistance programs
Employee discounts and perks
