jobs.title: VP of Engineering (hands-on)
jobs.description:
Headways helps enterprises with their AI transformation.
Our Field Deployment Engineers embed inside a customer, capture how the best people actually do the work, and codify it into AI routines that keep running inside the organization, governed, auditable, and measurable. We're deploying at technology and healthcare companies today, with six-figure contracts, a healthy pipeline, and Tim Mayopoulos (former CEO of Fannie Mae) as an advisor.

We're hiring our first engineering leader. If you are someone who is opinionated about how AI-native software gets engineered, wants to own a codebase and is excited to grow a team, please apply.

What you'll own

The codebase and the technical roadmap.
You decide what gets built, how, and in what order. You write code most days. This is not a managing-from-the-side role and won't be for a while.
Product velocity.
Our team shipped a production platform by building with AI-first. Your job is to make that faster and more focused with customer feedback. We'd rather cut scope than cut speed.
Deploying with customers.
You'll be on site and in the room when we deploy: watching how a customer's team actually uses what we built, taking the feedback, and turning it into the next platform change. Nobody here builds blind. The roadmap comes from deployments, and you'll have seen the problem before you fix it.
High-trust deployment.
Our customers hand us their Salesforce, Epic, SharePoint, and Teams data, and some of it is PHI. Security, governance, and data integration are the product, not a checklist.
The engineering team.
You'll hire the first engineers and set how they work. Early on that's one or two people; it grows with the customer base.
"Everyone is a builder."
We want support and FDEs building routines and connectors themselves. Engineering's job is to draw the boundaries: what's safe for non-engineers to build, what needs review, and what stays in the core. You'll design that system.

What's already built

This is a real platform, not a prototype. You inherit:

A TypeScript monorepo (Turborepo, pnpm) running at app.headways.ai: Hono API, React Router 7 product app, DBOS background workflows, an agent runtime with sandbox and egress policies, an ingest service, and connector adapters for the systems our customers run on.
Postgres with Prisma and SpiceDB for the authorization graph.
Production on GCP: GKE with per-service Helm charts, Terraform, Secret Manager, Falco, pgcat, Metabase and dbt for analytics. CI/CD through GitHub Actions with Postgres-backed test runs.
An AI-native development workflow: spec-and-plan docs in the repo, agent-driven implementation, and conventions written for both humans and models.

Some of it is over-built for a team this size, and there's dormant code to retire. Part of the job is deciding what to simplify and what to delete.

Who you are

You've designed and shipped complex enterprise software, and you've been the person who owned the whole system, not one service of it.
You like being in front of customers. Not selling, but watching people use the thing, hearing what's wrong, and fixing it. If you'd rather never leave the editor, this will be a frustrating job.
TypeScript full-stack is your home. You've run Kubernetes in production and can read Terraform well.
You've done real data integration work: connectors, ETL, permissions, the ugly parts.
You take security and governance seriously because you've been on the wrong side of a breach, an audit, or a customer security review.
You've led a small team before, or you've been the obvious person a team followed, and you want to do it properly this time.
You're fine with uncertainty but not looking for a science project. There are paying customers, a working system, and a pipeline. You want to build, see the growth, and lead.

Healthcare or agent-runtime experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Details

Location: San Mateo, CA, in person most days.
Compensation: salary, very meaningful equity, and ownership.
Reports to: Michael Ke Zhang, CEO. You'd work daily with Eric Smejkal, Head of Product, who also ships code.

Let us know your interest

You can quick apply here in Linkedin. But if you want to get serious attention, email mkz@headways.ai with a link to something you built. No cover letter.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Lithography Process Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Sustaining Operations

Maintain and optimize lithography processes in high volume manufacturing environments.
Build a high-performing organization with disciplined, strong execution, data-driven decision making, and continuous improvement via process SPC control.
Allocate team resources to critical business priorities and ensure appropriate coverage of process related holds and execution activities across required or extended operating hours.
Establish consistent processes, governance, and accountability across the functions while recognizing legitimate site-specific operational requirements.

Process Development & Transfers

Lead the development, validation, and transfer of new or modified photolithography processes.
Translate demand and business priorities into feasible process development plans, short-loop wafer requirements, troubleshooting plans, and scheduling priorities, as applicable.
Identify capacity, material, and process constraints and coordinate mitigation plans with Operations, Integration engineering, Program Management, Demand Management, and other stakeholders.
Ensure plans are regularly reconciled to actual factory conditions and revised as business priorities change.
Support the integration of new photolithography equipment and techniques, including EUV and advanced scanner technologies.

Yield & Quality Improvement

Drive yield improvements, defect reduction, eliminate photolithography misalignment issues, and cost savings through root cause analysis and process control.
Partner with Manufacturing and Operations to minimize hold issues via solid development phase.
Drive timely recovery actions when execution deviates from plan and escalate issues requiring cross-functional or leadership decisions.
Balance near-term execution requirements with longer-term customer-service objectives.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner effectively with different process module teams, manufacturing and site operations, integration engineering, equipment engineering, Quality, IT, to resolve manufacturing and development issues.
Manage and mentor process engineers and technicians, ensuring technical excellence and operational stability.
Communicate significant execution risks clearly to leadership and drive timely decisions and corrective actions.

Education & Experience

This position requires strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills; an ability to function in a collaborative and collegial environment; high integrity and intelligence; excellent judgment; a conceptual thinker - strategic as well as pragmatic; and an ability to generate trust and build alliances with co-workers.

Oversight of the security, reliability, and availability of the organization’s information technology environment encompassing networks, hardware, software, telecommunications services, enterprise and utility-specific applications, end-user support services, disaster recovery and ensuring business continuity.

Directing and integrating information technology staff, contractors, and consultants engaged in the support, development, design, implementation, maintenance, and security of wired and wireless networks, telecommunications services, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, utility-related systems, and desktop hardware and software applications deployed throughout the organization.

This position is part of the senior leadership team and is responsible for ensuring that any IT implications associated with other significant initiatives across the organization are appropriately considered and evaluated.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities (essential Functions)

Technology Leadership and Advocacy:

Work with the senior leadership team to set the strategic information technology direction for the utility and the IT team.

Continuously monitor innovation within the field of technology by observing "best of breed" companies, within the water reclamation industry and beyond to advise the best course to take when making technology decisions.

Develop, implement, and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap aligned with LRWRA’s strategic objectives, identifying short- and long-term initiatives for infrastructure, systems, and applications, and clearly identifying operating and capital budget impacts.

Participate in and represent the organization at selected professional associations, user groups, and industry forums as appropriate to organizational needs.

IT Program Management

Responsible for IT department resources including management, coordination, and assistance for all hardware, software, network and other information system related services, projects, programs, and the integration of these activities into the overall LRWRA plan.

Accountable for development and oversight of the IT operating and capital budgets and resource utilization.

Ensure that core hardware, software, and systems required by employees are available, reliable and effective.

Ensure the security and recoverability of LRWRA IT systems, networks and data.

Direct the organization’s efforts to protect networks, systems, applications, and data from cybersecurity threats using risk-based practices appropriate to a municipal utility environment.

Define, monitor, and report on key information technology and cybersecurity performance indicators, and maintain awareness of relevant regulatory, legal, and industry developments affecting municipal and utility technology operations.

Develop, maintain, and periodically test IT disaster recovery and business continuity plans to ensure continuity of critical services.

Coordinate with operational, engineering, and administrative departments to support acquisition, implementation and operation of utility-specific applications, including coordination related to operational technology (OT) and control systems, as applicable, while clearly defining roles and responsibilities to avoid overlap.

Employee Management And Development

Provide strategic and day-to-day leadership and direction to the Information Technology Department, ensuring a high-performance, service-oriented environment aligned with the mission, vision, and values of LRWRA.

Plan, organize, manage, and evaluate the work of the IT Department and, in coordination with peers, develop, implement, and monitor work plans, priorities, and performance measures to achieve organizational goals and objectives.

Create and maintain a culture of customer service that includes effective internal partnerships, practical service delivery, and responsiveness to organizational needs, with awareness of impacts to ratepayers and the public.

Other

Serve as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, contributing technology guidance to organizational planning and decision-making.

Maintain a valid Arkansas driver’s license and the ability to operate company vehicles, as required for travel between facilities or response to critical incidents.

LEVEL OF SUPERVISION RECEIVED

Works with minimal supervision.

Exercises sound, independent judgment in resolving most situations and determining appropriate courses of action, escalating issues based on organizational risk or operational impact.

Responsible for the productivity and performance of the Information Technology Department, providing leadership, coaching, and oversight for approximately five IT staff members, including the Director position.

TOTAL POSITIONS SUPERVISED

Directly supervises two non-director IT staff members and provides indirect supervision and functional leadership to remaining IT personnel.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

Required

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field from an accredited college or university.

Minimum of ten years of progressively responsible information technology experience, including at least five years of supervisory or leadership experience over IT professionals.

Any equivalent combination of education, experience, and certifications that provide the required knowledge, skills, and abilities may be considered.

Demonstrated ability to lead technology services in a small to mid-sized organization, balancing strategic planning with hands-on involvement.

Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize competing initiatives in a resource-constrained environment.

Strong professional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Demonstrated skills in problem solving, conflict resolution, and collaborative decision-making.

Preferred

Licensures, Certifications, and Registrations

Relevant professional certifications related to information security, IT governance, or project management (such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, ITIL, or comparable credentials) are preferred but not required.

jobs.title: VP, AI Platform
jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, one of the fastest-growing companies in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

The Opportunity

Engine is scaling fast: 1,000+ employees, moving upmarket, and using AI to fuel growth. The proof is already in production: 95.2% of merged production code is AI written, we ship roughly 1,300 pull requests a week (up from 800 a year ago, with fewer engineers), and we have restructured teams from 7 engineers to 5 with a gated path to 3. This is one of the most AI mature engineering organizations anywhere, and it is about to go further.

To do that coherently, Engine is standing up an AI native operating model with three coequal foundations: AI Platform builds the technical rails, Applied AI ships workflow redesign embedded in every domain, and Workforce Transformation updates the operating system. You lead the first.

AI Platform is what everything runs on. Without a single, trusted stack, every team forks its own plumbing and no one can measure or govern what ships. You will not be starting from zero: you inherit a founding team that includes a Principal Architect, a Principal Engineer dedicated to the AI harness, staff level product operations and analytics, and open reqs in flight. As the founding VP, you set the technical strategy, build hands on in the early phase, and scale the org through a Director and principal engineers as adoption proves out. You sit on The Triad with the Senior Director, Applied AI and the Senior Director, Workforce Transformation, prioritizing the enterprise AI roadmap and resolving cross domain calls.

What You'll Own

AI Platform core.
The LLM gateway, agent framework, prompt and agent libraries, and evaluation infrastructure: the rails every Applied AI team and every engineer builds on.
Developer experience and the Velocity program.
The AI harness, coding agents, testing and autonomy frameworks, and the coverage gates that unlock code merging without human review. This group owns Engine's product delivery cycle time number and is the engine that turns 95.2% AI written code into true autonomy. It is the crown jewel of the role.
Product operations, rebuilt as software.
We believe product operations becomes an AI native function. This team builds and runs that software: instrumented cadences, automated reporting, gap analysis, and the PD maturity scorecard. It runs the machinery of the PDLC, not the judgment inside it. An AI Product Ops Lead reports into this role.
Automation engineering and APIs.
Shared APIs, orchestration, and integrations: the rails every automation across Engine uses.
AI data infrastructure.

One stack, enterprise wide.

Team.

What You Bring

Experience.

Platform and infrastructure leadership at scale.

Deep AI systems expertise.

Security and responsible AI judgment.
You build security, privacy, and safe use controls into AI infrastructure by default.

jobs.description:
About us- Cognex is the largest, most successful and recognized global player in industrial machine vision! We are a financially strong, international company with no debt and have been in business for over 40 years. Using advanced optics, image sensors and artificial intelligence software Cognex vision and ID systems capture an image then analyze it to make sense of what’s being seen. We are deeply committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable work environment, guided by our "Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast" culture, which celebrates employee innovation, determination, and dedication in a dynamic, fun, and distinctive atmosphere .

We are working on a hybrid schedule: 3 days in the office, 2 at home.

Cognex is looking for a Director of Software Engineering to own the strategy, technical direction, and delivery of an Applied AI platform that will re-define how customers configure, manage and optimize industrial automation solutions on factory floors and in logistics operations. This is a highly visible leadership role with a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI-powered industrial automation. This role blends applied R&D, platform engineering, product delivery, and organizational leadership, turning emerging AI research into secure, reliable and scalable production-grade capabilities that create measurable customer value in the demanding realities of industrial manufacturing and logistics operations.

Key Responsibilities

Set the technical vision and multi-year roadmap for a new Applied AI platform to simplify complex, multi-step customer workflows across Cognex’s product portfolio.
Direct applied R&D on emerging AI capabilities, with structured experimentation and prototyping and a clear path from research to production.
Lead architecture decisions spanning embedded devices, edge compute, and cloud services and infrastructure, ensuring seamless experiences across hybrid experiences.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, cost efficiency and operational excellences of the services that power the platform, including APIs, model-serving infrastructure, data pipelines, and connected experiences.
Establish the engineering standards, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and operational practices (SLAs, on-call, incident response) required to deliver trustworthy AI systems in production, balancing capability, reliability, latency, safety, and operating cost.
Partner with Product, R&D, UX, and Hardware organizations to turn ambiguous problems into shipped capabilities, on committed timelines.
Drive adoption of the platform across Cognex's product portfolio, enabling product teams to rapidly build and consume shared AI capabilities and services.
Track the fast-moving AI landscape and translate external advances into pragmatic bets for Cognex.
Drive cost efficiency, observability, and continuous delivery across cloud and hybrid (edge-plus-cloud) deployments, with privacy and security built in.
Grow, lead, and mentor a high-impact engineering organization, building a culture of ownership, technical rigor and execution excellence

Role Requirements

15+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in senior engineering leadership roles managing managers and/or multiple engineering teams, with a proven track record of building high-performing organizations, delivering business-critical products, and driving technical strategy.
Track record of shipping and scaling complex platforms and cloud/online services in production.
Experience leading R&D or applied-research efforts from concept to shipped product
Demonstrated experience turning ambiguous customer problems into shipped products, scalable products and technical strategy
Deep expertise in backend/cloud architecture, API design and platform engineering.
Hands-on familiarity with modern AI application architectures, including LLMOps, agentic systems, tool integration, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol, and evaluation harness design, prompt management, and production observability.
Strong strategic and execution-oriented mindset, with the ability to balance ambitious AI innovation against reliability, scalability, cost, and deployment constraints.
Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align technical teams, executives, customers, and cross-functional partners around a shared vision and execution plan.
Customer-focused leadership approach, with a passion for solving real-world customer problems through innovative software platforms and AI-driven experiences.

Preferred Experience & Qualifications

Computer vision, machine learning inference, or edge/embedded deployment systems.
Background in industrial automation, manufacturing, robotics, or logistics.
Experience productizing AI capabilities at scale, beyond prototypes and proof-of-concepts.
Experience working with developer platforms, APIs, SDKs, or ecosystems that enable other teams to build and innovate more quickly.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field.

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance or a sales incentive plan.

This position is also eligible for equity under the Cognex Equity Program.

This position provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching; employer-paid disability, family leave, life insurance, paid time off (including holidays), optional voluntary benefits, and recognition and wellness programs.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management - Platform
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

Note: This position requires presence in our Bellevue or San Francisco office location 4 days per week; Lambda's designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

About The Role

Every product Lambda ships depends on horizontal capabilities: the security and identity surfaces that let enterprise customers trust us, the telemetry and observability that tells us and our customers what the fleet is doing, and the metering and billing that turns per-minute GPU usage and committed cluster contracts into accurate invoices. When the platform layer is coherent, every Lambda product gets stronger at once. That is the leverage of this role.

You'll lead Lambda's Platform product group as a player-coach. You'll hire and manage three product managers, one each for Security, Observability, and Billing, all opening now. While you build that team, you'll personally own platform product strategy: the roadmap, the priorities, and the tradeoffs. You'll partner directly with platform engineering leadership. This is a first-line product management manager role, and you'll set the bar your team is measured against.

Great product managers at Lambda are defined by three things: insight, influence, and execution. Insight means you look at the data, determine what it means for customers and business, and then figure out what to do about it. But, a great idea doesn’t mean anything in a vacuum. That is where influence comes in. Influence means you take that idea and get others to want to buy into it; you win over engineers, designers, executives, and partners without relying on authority. But a great idea that everyone is excited about doesn’t matter unless it is delivered to customers. Execution means you work with the right people to get the idea launched, then measure and iterate. We hire product managers who learn new domains fast and reason rigorously from evidence. Deep domain depth in cloud platforms makes you stronger, but insight, influence, and execution are the bar.

Success in this role looks like two things: a platform layer that enterprise customers can trust, and a hired, high-performing product management team that clears the bar you set. If you love building the connective tissue of a cloud, and you want to grow product managers while still doing the work yourself, we'd love to hear from you.

We value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and skills, and we are excited to hear from candidates who can bring unique perspectives to our team. If you do not exactly meet this description but believe you may be a good fit, please still apply and help us understand your readiness for this role.

What You'll Do

Build the Team: Hire, manage, and develop the Security, Observability, and Billing product managers, and set the standard for insight, influence, and execution across the Platform product group.
Own the Roadmap: Define and own the platform roadmap end to end across security, observability, and billing, and hold it accountable to customer and business outcomes.
Carry the Strategy Yourself: Personally own platform product strategy while the team is being hired, so the roadmap never waits on headcount.
Strengthen Every Product: Deliver horizontal capabilities that On-Demand GPU Instances, 1-Click Clusters, and the Lambda Cloud API all depend on, rather than one-off features for a single product line.
Get Metering and Billing Right: Own the product surface for usage-based GPU compute billing, from per-minute on-demand billing to committed multi-node cluster contracts, so every invoice is accurate and explainable.
Earn Enterprise Trust: Shape the identity and security surfaces that let enterprise ML (machine learning) teams adopt Lambda with confidence.
Partner with Platform Engineering: Work side by side with platform engineering leadership on sequencing, tradeoffs, and delivery, so strategy and architecture move together.
Decide with Data: Turn fleet telemetry, usage patterns, and customer signal into clear build decisions, and communicate the what, the so what, and the now what to executives and customers.

You

Have 10+ years of product management experience, including experience shipping platform or infrastructure products that other teams build on
Have 3+ years hiring and managing product managers, or have formally led product managers as a first-line manager
Turn ambiguous data and customer signal into a clear decision about what to build next, and can show where you've done it
Win engineers, designers, executives, and customers over to your ideas without relying on organizational authority
Work with the right people to get products launched, then measure and iterate rather than moving on
Are comfortable operating as a player-coach, owning strategy directly while building the team that will own it after you
Can go deep with engineering leadership on technical tradeoffs and hold your own in architecture discussions
Communicate in writing clearly enough that an executive can act on your document without a follow-up meeting
Able to define iterative plans that move an organization from the current state towards the desired outcome

Nice to Have

Have shipped metering, billing, or monetization systems for usage-based products
Have built identity, security, or compliance product surfaces for enterprise customers
Have built telemetry or observability products, or worked deeply with tools like Prometheus and Grafana
Have a background in GPU compute, high performance computing, or AI infrastructure
Have built a product team from zero, including writing the job descriptions and running the hiring loops

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

About Lambda

Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast
Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove
We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG
Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers
We offer generous cash & equity compensation
Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles
401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)
Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer

Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

Compensation Range: $365K - $540K

jobs.title: Senior Director, eDiscovery Technology
jobs.description:
About the role

KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. The eDiscovery Technology practice is where those clients meet advanced analytics and AI: technology-assisted review, generative AI classification for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and the non-standard workflows that turn a hard matter into a defensible, efficient one. Clients across the US, UK, Europe, and Asia Pacific are asking how to use AI in discovery and how to defend it, each under their own rules. This practice answers them everywhere KLD operates.
The Senior Director, eDiscovery Technology leads that practice globally. You will lead a team of technologists and consultants across time zones, own the methodology and defensibility of every AI-assisted workflow we deliver, partner with Advisory to package and price the consulting offerings they sell, and sit at the table with Product and Engineering as we build AI review into our own platform. This is applied legal technology leadership rather than a software engineering role, and a legal background is preferred.

What you will do

Lead the eDiscovery Technology practice

Lead a team of eDiscovery technologists and consultants who design and run advanced analytics and AI-assisted workflows on client matters, including technology-assisted review and continuous active learning, generative AI review for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and custom workflow design for non-standard tools and data.
Run the practice on a billable model: request intake, scoping, staffing, utilization, quality, and turnaround, against a demand curve that is growing fast.
Run it as one global practice, with one intake, one standard, and one set of playbooks across the US, EMEA, and APAC. Build follow-the-sun handoffs so a matter started in London or Hong Kong is picked up cleanly in the US, and partner with regional Operations leaders on staffing, skills, and coverage.
Grow the practice. Hire, onboard, and develop a manager, consultants, and technologists as demand expands, and build a career path from technologist to consultant to lead.
Build the operating rhythm: intake standards, capacity forecasting, coverage for second-shift, weekend, and deadline-driven work, quality standards, and playbooks so every matter gets the same standard regardless of who staffs it.

Own the methodology and its defensibility

Own how KLD applies analytics and AI to review: TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, generative AI classifiers for relevance and privilege, prompt design and iteration, validation statistics (recall, precision, elusion), and the documentation that makes the result defensible.
Serve as the senior subject matter expert for clients and counsel on AI-assisted review: scoping, protocol support, validation design, and explaining results in plain language to lawyers who have to sign their name to them.
Build reusable playbooks, prompt libraries, validation templates, and reporting so quality lives in the practice rather than in any one person.
Own AI governance for client matters with Legal and InfoSec: client data boundaries, client-specific AI restrictions, privilege protections, and audit trail, applied consistently across every tool the practice uses.
Adapt the methodology to the jurisdiction without lowering the standard: US TAR and GenAI case law and protocols, UK disclosure practice, GDPR and UK data protection, cross-border transfer and data residency limits, and APAC requirements, so the same playbook is defensible in every region where we run it.

Co-own the consulting offerings with Advisory

Partner with Advisory and Sales to define, package, and price the AI and analytics consulting offerings they sell: what we offer, how it is scoped, what it costs to deliver, and what margin it carries.
Supply the technical authority in pursuits Advisory leads across regions: pre-sales calls, RFP responses, pilots, and client education sessions for US, UK, European, and APAC clients and law firms.
Move the practice from reactive technical support toward productized consulting with clear deliverables, pricing, and outcomes.
Track offering revenue, attach rate, billable utilization, revenue per consultant per week, and margin, and report them into the weekly and monthly business reviews.

Partner with Product and Engineering

Serve as the practice’s voice into KLD’s own AI review capabilities: requirements, pilot design, operational readiness, adoption, and the feedback loop from client matters back to the roadmap.
Evaluate and adopt third-party analytics and AI tools, run structured comparisons, and own the practice’s vendor relationships and licensing.
Work with Process Engineering to encode repeatable workflows into automation and AI skills so the team’s time goes to judgment rather than mechanics.

Lead clients and cross-functional partners

Act as the senior technical voice for Client Success, Sales, and clients in every region on complex matters, escalations, and methodology questions, including cross-border matters that span more than one jurisdiction.
Represent the practice externally with a clear point of view on AI in discovery, thought leadership, and industry presence.
Lead with KLD’s values: Client is Always in the Room, Better Every Day, Own the Outcome, and Deliver Results Together.

What you will Bring

Required

10+ years in eDiscovery or litigation technology, including 5+ years applying advanced analytics and AI-assisted review on client matters and 3+ years leading a team.
Deep hands-on expertise in TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, and generative AI review (Relativity aiR, eDiscovery AI, or equivalent), including prompt design, validation statistics, and defensibility documentation. Working command of Relativity and RelativityOne.
A client-facing record: you have scoped, defended, and explained AI-assisted review to counsel and clients, supported protocol negotiations, and handled the hard questions.
Multi-jurisdiction experience: you have delivered analytics or AI-assisted review on matters outside the US or for non-US clients, and you understand GDPR, cross-border data transfer constraints, and how disclosure practice in the UK, EU, or APAC differs from US discovery.
Commercial fluency: you have packaged or priced consulting work, partnered with sales on pursuits, and can explain utilization and margin to a CFO.
Product partnership experience as the operational or practitioner voice on AI feature design, pilots, or adoption.
A record of building and developing a technical consulting team, including growing leads into managers and leading people across time zones.
A direct, clear communication style. You can explain recall and elusion to a general counsel and to a first-year technologist in the same afternoon.
Experience in PE-backed or high-growth environments where pace and accountability are the norm.

Preferred

Legal degree (JD or equivalent); bar admission a plus.
Structured analytics experience (Brainspace, Reveal, or similar).
Declaration or testimony experience on review methodology.
Relativity certifications, CEDS, or equivalent.

Our mission and core values:
We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.

Client is Always in the Room.
We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.

Better Every Day.
We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.

Own the Outcome.
We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients and each other.

Deliver Results Together.
We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.

Our culture shapes our actions, our products, and the relationships we forge with our customers.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Overview

The IT Director provides enterprise-level leadership for BerryDunn’s technology strategy, operations, and modernization efforts in support of a geographically distributed workforce, multiple office locations, and the firm’s continued growth. This role shapes the vision and direction for IT infrastructure, enterprise systems, business applications, architecture, data platforms, and digital transformation, ensuring technology capabilities enable strategic priorities, operational effectiveness, service reliability, and future growth. Leading the IT Leadership Team, the IT Director serves as a strategic business leader, leveraging technology, data, automation, and artificial intelligence to strengthen client service, improve operational scalability and employee experience, and support the firm’s long-term growth.

Travel Expectations:
This role requires minimal travel, less than 10% per year.

You Will

Lead the development and execution of a multi-year IT strategic and operational plan that positions IT as a proactive partner in firm growth, transformation, service excellence, and operational effectiveness.
Establish IT goals, governance practices, service expectations, and performance measures that strengthen accountability, reliability, and operational excellence.
Develop and manage annual operating and capital budgets, technology forecasts, business cases, sourcing strategies, vendor investments, and multi-year investment roadmaps that optimize firm value, cost effectiveness, resource capacity, and service quality.
Establish enterprise architecture practices, including technology standards, solution design governance, integration patterns, platform roadmaps, and technical debt management.
Oversee internal systems, enterprise applications, data platforms, integrations, and databases to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with firm architecture standards.
Lead evaluation, governance, and adoption of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, automation, and productivity platforms, to improve business outcomes while aligning with risk, cybersecurity, data protection, and compliance requirements.
Advance observability and performance insight across IT systems, including service health, application performance, incident trends, availability, reliability, and KPI reporting.
Partner with firm leaders and transformation stakeholders to prioritize and deliver technology initiatives that improve client service, operational efficiency, automation, digital enablement, and business outcomes.
Collaborate with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and business continuity stakeholders to align technology decisions with security requirements, data protection expectations, and firm risk priorities.
Partner with business leaders to govern technology demand, prioritize the IT portfolio, and balance resource capacity, business value, risk, and strategic objectives.
Lead technology-enabled change by building stakeholder alignment and readiness and coordinating communication, training, adoption, and sustained use of new systems and tools.
Promote continuous learning and innovation across IT through knowledge sharing, technical development, communities of practice, and ongoing capability building.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Lead and develop the IT Leadership Team, fostering a culture of empowerment, collaboration, innovation, and accountability.
Oversee recruitment, development, retention, and succession planning for IT staff.
Define, communicate, and engage others in strategic plans, policies, and technology standards across all levels of the firm.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with external partners, vendors, and industry associations to enhance IT strategy and capabilities.

You Have

jobs.description:
Paperless Parts is the SaaS-based intelligence layer for modern manufacturing, enabling our customers to innovate faster in the physical world. From rockets to medical devices, we power the parts that move the world forward.

Location:
Boston, MA (Hybrid) Reports To:
Chief Technology Officer Employment Type:
Full-Time Travel:
5–10%

This position requires activities that are subject to US Export Control Laws and require US Citizenship or Green Card Holder.

The Opportunity

Four years ago Paperless Parts was a startup. Today it's a scale-up with an engineering team that ships reliably, a platform that's changing how manufacturers quote and run their business, and a customer base that keeps growing. The next chapter is new product lines and faster growth, and we need a VP of Engineering to lead that shift. You'll report to the CTO and run a 25+ person organization through two Directors of Engineering, working as a peer to the VP of Product and Chief Scientist. The job is two jobs at once: keep the core platform stable and improving for customers who depend on it daily, while standing up new products in a market where AI is changing what's possible to build and how fast you can build it. Whoever takes this on has to be good at both, and has to make the team better at both.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

The next product line is in market, with real customers live on it and generating revenue, on a platform built to scale; proof Paperless Parts can build a second product the market wants, not just defend the first one.
The team has moved from using AI inside the SDLC to running an AI-native SDLC, one built on a first-class engineering culture, with people still at the center of how software gets made.
Successful delivery means customer value landed, not tickets closed; Engineering and Product move as one team toward customer-facing measure of success.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Operations:
Own engineering delivery, quality, and predictability, establishing an operational rhythm the broader company depends on.
Technical Direction:
Own the architecture and platform decisions that set our foundation for the next stage. New products mean new architecture, and the choices made now set the tone for how we build for years to come.
Product Partnership:
Partner with the VP of Product on a roadmap that delivers real value to customers, sharing ownership of sequencing, trade-offs, and the commitments we make. Engineering brings feasibility, cost, and options to the table early, not after the plan is set.
Manufacturing Intelligence:
Partner with the Chief Scientist on the development and execution of our manufacturing intelligence strategy, bringing new AI-driven capability to market.
AI Leverage:
We have adopted AI across the engineering organization. Lead the next step: maximize its leverage to shape how we work for the future, while holding the line on quality.
Platform Efficiency:
Keep the core platform cheaper to run, faster to change, and more reliable as customer volume grows.
Leadership and Team Growth:
Coach Directors and Engineering Managers, establish clear career paths that develop and retain strong engineers, and direct the hiring plan and selection standard so the team grows without compromising technical or cultural quality.
Executive Leadership:
Represent engineering status, capacity, risks, and strategic tradeoffs clearly to the executive leadership team.

Qualifications & Experience

Core Requirements

Scale Experience:
Demonstrated track record of leading multi-team B2B SaaS engineering organizations through growth phases while continuously improving delivery quality and predictability.
Management Depth:
Proven success managing through Directors and Engineering Managers, with evidence of developing frontline leaders.
Modern SaaS Architecture:
Deep technical background in cloud-native platforms, with a track record of architectural decisions that scale under increasing customer load.
AI in Practice:
Experience raising an engineering team's effectiveness with AI tooling and AI-enabled product capability, with a clear point of view on where it works and where it does not.
Product Alignment:
Strong experience partnering with Product leadership to align technical roadmap priorities with commercial objectives.
Location:
US-based (Boston, MA hybrid).

Preferred Qualifications

New Product Execution:
Hands-on experience taking new product lines from early customer traction to scaled commercial production within an established organization.
Domain & Compliance Awareness:
Experience operating within security-conscious software environments (FedRAMP, etc.) or industrial/manufacturing SaaS sectors.

Salary range:

$215,000 - $310,000 base salary. This role is also eligible for a competitive variable bonus and equity opportunity

The job posting range is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, sales or revenue-based metrics, and business or organizational needs.

Paperless Parts Life

Culture:
At Paperless Parts, we value intentionality, persistence and relationships. We live and breathe these values every day. As a fast-growing company, we're continually improving what we've built while still building from the ground up.

Boston Office:
Our office is full of energy; people regularly collaborate to solve complex problems. We recognize that people work well in different environments and have intentionally designed our office to provide collaborative spaces and quiet focus areas. Our height-adjustable desks are set up with additional monitors, and employees are provided with the latest Apple technology to support productivity.

Our headquarters is located in downtown Boston, MA and easily accessible to most transit routes (Red/Blue/Orange/Green Line/South Station/North Station).

Encinitas Office:
Our California office is our newest office which seats our West Coast sales team. The office has an open floor plan with several conference rooms to encourage collaboration with your colleagues in California and TV's to connect with those sitting in Boston or remotely. The office is walking distance from Downtown Encinitas, the Coaster train stop, and tons of activities on the 101.

We value you and your family. With this in mind, full-time employees are provided:

100% coverage of health, dental, and vision for you and your dependent
Competitive compensation philosophy
Unlimited PTO
13+ paid holidays
Company-sponsored wellness stipend
Pre-tax Commuter and FSA/Dependent Care FSA
401(k) plan
Employee recognition program

Responsible for adherence to all security and privacy requirements, rules and regulations and implement as required.

Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

U.S. Bank is seeking an accomplished Software Engineering Director
to lead the strategy, execution, and modernization of digital platforms supporting Wealth, Corporate, Commercial, and Institutional Banking (WCIB). This leader will drive innovation, engineering excellence, cloud adoption, and digital transformation while ensuring scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise solutions that enhance the client experience and support business growth. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across a complex organization.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop high-performing software engineering teams responsible for delivering enterprise digital solutions across WCIB platforms.
Define and execute the long-term technology strategy, roadmap, and modernization initiatives aligned with business objectives.
Oversee the design, development, deployment, and support of scalable, secure, and resilient digital applications.
Partner with executive leadership, product teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize investments and technology initiatives.
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices, including Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, cloud-native development, and automation.
Establish engineering standards, architecture governance, and best practices to improve quality, performance, and maintainability.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, risk, security, and data protection requirements across all digital platforms.
Lead large-scale technology transformation initiatives, including cloud migration, platform modernization, and digital innovation programs.

About Type One Energy

Type One Energy Group is mission-driven to provide sustainable, affordable fusion power to the world. Established in 2019 and venture-backed in 2023, the company is led by a team of globally recognized fusion scientists with a strong track record of building state-of-the-art stellarator fusion machines, together with veteran business leaders experienced in scaling companies and commercializing energy technologies.

If you are searching for the best new ideas and share our vision, join us as a Director of Engineering
. This is what you need to know:
Location:
Knoxville, TN
Salary:
Highly Competitive Plus Benefits
Contract:
Permanent, full time
Reporting to:
Senior VP of Engineering

Your role in the mission:

The Director of Engineering is responsible for building, developing, and sustaining a high-performing multidisciplinary engineering organization consisting of more than 100 engineers across Mechanical, Electrical, Software, Systems, CAD/Design, Test, and other technical disciplines.
Reporting directly to the SVP of Engineering, this role serves as the senior leader responsible for organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, leadership development, succession readiness, employee engagement, and engineering capability growth. The Director works closely with engineering functional leaders, technical authorities, and program leadership to ensure the engineering organization is staffed, developed, and structured to meet both current and future business needs.
This position is intentionally focused on organizational leadership rather than technical direction or program execution. Technical priorities, engineering decisions, and project execution are owned by the matrixed engineering functional leadership and program management organizations.
The successful candidate is a strategic organizational leader who combines business acumen, workforce planning expertise, and a passion for developing people. They are comfortable operating in ambiguity, skilled at building alignment across diverse stakeholders, and committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture where individuals can thrive and grow.
Organizational Leadership

Partner with the SVP of Engineering to develop and implement the long-term organizational strategy for Engineering.
Design and continuously improve the organizational structure to support company growth and evolving business needs.
Drive organizational effectiveness initiatives that improve collaboration, communication, and employee engagement.
Establish and promote a positive, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture.
Lead organizational change initiatives and promote adoption of new business and workforce strategies.
Serve as a key member of the Engineering Leadership Team.
Anticipate future workforce and organizational needs in response to changing business priorities and technologies
Influence outcomes across multiple stakeholders without direct authority through strong relationships, credibility, and communication.

Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition

Develop long-range engineering workforce strategies aligned with business growth objectives.
Partner with Human Resources and engineering leadership to forecast staffing requirements.
Support headcount planning and organizational capacity assessments.
Partner with recruiting teams and engineering leaders to support the attraction and retention of highly qualified engineering talent.
Evaluate workforce demographics, skills gaps, and future capability needs.
Develop strategies to support organizational scalability.

Leadership Development

Develop and coach engineering managers and emerging leaders.
Partner with Learning & Development on the implementation of leadership development programs for current and future engineering leaders.
Support the development of high-potential employees and future engineering leaders.
Partner with engineering leadership on talent reviews and succession planning activities.
Ensure continuity planning exists for key leadership and technical positions.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Technical Director, Traffic Engineering
to join our team in New York. This role can be based in any of the following NY offices: Valhalla, NYC, Buffalo, or Troy
.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Traffic Engineer who is innovative, results-oriented, and team-focused. The right candidate would be joining a tight-knit team of traffic engineers and transportation planners who value technical excellence, career development, pride in our work, a collaborative team environment, and a passion for finding the right solutions that enhance mobility and safety. The Technical Director, Traffic Engineering will bring and leadership skills to help grow our business, oversee project delivery and staff development, and provide technical assistance and guidance in engineering and design for our local, state, and regional clients. Our ideal candidate has a proven track record of successfully delivering projects from initiation through operations and maintenance, with a strong focus on client satisfaction and technical excellence. This position will primarily support projects in New York. .Some project-related travel may be required.

Your Impact

Support the delivery and execution of project scope, objectives, and requirements, ensuring close collaboration and alignment with clients and stakeholders. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues. Ensure project deliverables meet high-quality standards and specified requirements. Implement rigorous quality review processes, manage version controls, and track comments and resolutions. Monitor and meet defined performance metrics, tracking budget, time, scope, and communication details to ensure projects meet schedule and client expectations.

Passion for innovation, quality, and financial performance

Strong ability to quickly adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to a variety of schedules and hours to meet business needs.

Master’s Degree in Engineering.
Active engagement in relevant industry organizations.
Project experience - Traffic operations and safety, ATSPM, signal design, signal timing, NYSDOT experience, Interstate Reconstruction, Environmental Impact Statements.
Expertise in traffic engineering principles, practices, NYSDOT project delivery process, Traffic Signal Design, Signage, pavement markings, Maco, Meso and Micro-simulation modeling.

new_jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Head of Engineering, Climbing Robotics for Critical Infrastructure

We are working with a well funded, early stage robotics company building a genuinely new category of climbing robot for critical infrastructure, including electrical transmission networks, pipelines, bridges, industrial tanks, shipbuilding, renewable energy assets and data centers. Rather than drones or conventional inspection methods, the platform uses proprietary magnetic locomotion to climb steel structures and physically interact with them, with a long term roadmap extending into contact measurement, corrosion analysis, grinding, welding preparation and bolt torque verification.

The company is on its third to fourth generation of robot development and is solving problems that simply do not have off the shelf answers yet, particularly around magnetic adhesion and actuator design. Strong customer interest already exists across the US, Canada and Europe, and the business is well capitalized heading into a significant funding round later this year, with no concerns around future fundraising.
About the role

This is a true player coach position, roughly 80 percent hands on engineering leadership and execution, 20 percent strategic planning. You will be the company's first true engineering leadership hire, working closely with the founders to introduce engineering process, structure and operational discipline while keeping the pace and culture that has gotten the company this far. You will not be inheriting a mature engineering organization, you will be helping build one, including laying the foundations needed for rapid growth after the upcoming raise. The title today is Head of Engineering, with a clear intention to promote into a VP Engineering position as the company scales rather than hiring externally for that seat.

What we are looking for

Robotics industry experience, ideally within legged robotics, field robotics or other complex autonomous systems. Strong systems engineering experience with testing and validation as a genuine part of your background. Experience building engineering organizations inside early stage startups, including introducing process and structure rather than inheriting it. Around five years of engineering leadership experience, including managing small engineering teams and, where possible, managers. Strong technical credibility across robotics software, C++, ROS2 and simulation or modeling tools. Experience balancing customer needs with engineering priorities during rapid product development. A genuine appreciation for robotics operating in harsh outdoor environments where reliability is critical.

What will make you successful here is calm, experienced leadership, comfort working in ambiguity, a willingness to build process from scratch, being a strong communicator who asks good questions rather than chasing every new idea, staying pragmatic and execution focused, being comfortable changing direction when needed, using AI as a genuine engineering productivity tool, and being more motivated by building meaningful technology than by maximizing salary. Low ego and collaborative colleagues who are enjoyable to work with matter a great deal here.

At Strive Health, patients come first. We’re on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey.

Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You’ll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you’ll feel right at home at Strive!

Benefits & Perks

Hybrid-Remote Flexibility – Work from home while fulfilling in-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits.
Comprehensive Benefits – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts.
Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation with a performance-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources.
Time Off & Leave – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves.

.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop a team of Software and Data Engineers spanning multiple pods — providing regular coaching, performance feedback, and career development guidance across a range of seniority levels. Accountable for sustaining ≥80% on-time delivery against sprint. commitments and initiative targets.
Operate within a hands-on technical leadership role with roughly 60% of your time spent towards AWS architecture and writing Python and 40% leading and developing a team. The ideal candidate is a senior manager with strong AWS foundation who stays close to the work, regularly contributes code, and mentors both their own team and others across the AWS stack.
Own engineering delivery process health across teams — including sprint goal stewardship, sprint capacity planning, and cross-team delivery accountability in the absence of dedicated Scrum Masters.
Drive adoption of quality engineering standards including TDD, BDD, or spec-driven development, with a goal of reducing P0 through P2 production incidents.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Betterment

Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager in Broker Dealer, you'll help balance on-time delivery of new features alongside system stability and scale, all while helping mentor and grow a team of talented engineers. Broker Dealer is the core of the Betterment platform. On a busy day, we securely move millions of dollars through the Betterment system and ensure each transaction flows through a complex series of risk checks for strict regulatory compliance. Every ounce of efficiency and intelligence we pour into this system translates into more value for our customers.

We’re looking for an Engineering leader to contribute to answering our most difficult backend scaling, software design, and optimization questions. This role will be overseeing a team of individual contributors, and will work closely with other engineering managers in Broker Dealer. While we don’t expect you to code on a daily basis, we do expect you to quickly familiarize yourself with the tech stack, codebase and specific business domains so that you can better support the team’s mission and deliver meaningful business impact.

This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.

New York City: $210,000-245,000

This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus.

A Day In The Life

Manage a team of 6-8 backend engineers who build innovative trading technology that powers our investing products.
Foster career development and align roadmap opportunities with each engineer’s growth interests, keeping them technically engaged.
Cultivate a team culture that values agility, accountability, constructive feedback, and celebrates successes.
Be a hands-on technical mentor by regularly diving into the codebase, participating in code reviews, partnering with stakeholders to shape solutions, and driving effective technical decision-making.
Champion maintainability and reliability by advocating for the long-term stability of the technology your team builds.
Balance the need for speed of delivery with the importance of correctness and quality in every project your team undertakes.
Continuously refine team processes and practices to deliver high-impact, high-quality outcomes for the business and ensure the appropriately engineered solutions.
Develop deep domain and industry knowledge to be a highly effective partner across internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal and Compliance teams to ensure we consistently deliver the right sized solutions to the right problems.

What We're Looking For

3+ years of experience in formal Engineering Management of direct reports.
8+ years of experience in building and maintaining backend distributed systems using Java or a similar strongly typed programming language.
Experience managing, mentoring, and inspiring talented engineers, guiding them toward excellence in both professional growth and project outcomes.
A proven track record to rapidly close knowledge gaps, enhancing productivity and establishing trust within the organization.
A history of fostering accountability and ownership, motivating teams to take initiative and consistently deliver right sized solutions.
Experience cultivating high-performing teams that focus on speed of execution and the rigor to maintain quality.
Ability to adjust leadership style to meet the evolving needs of the team and the business.
Effective collaborator capable of working with other engineering teams, product managers, subject matter experts, non-technical stakeholders and third party vendors to build and ship high quality software.
Ability to translate business strategy into Engineering initiatives that drive delivery of meaningful outcomes.

Join a team built on these core values

We change lives

Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease .

We set audacious goals

We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins.

We value all perspectives

When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community.

We simplify financial services

We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA.

Our Commitment To Your Total Well-being

We offer a competitive suite of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options
Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants.
Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year.
Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees.
Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments.

What Happens Next

We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues.

In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions.

On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process.

We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process!

Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.

Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Come join us!

The Director of New Technology functions as a senior-level technical specialist and manager of a small group who have the charter of identifying new technologies for B&W’s future portfolio growth. DUTIES
