How You’ll Make An Impact

At Strive Health, patients come first. We’re on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey.

Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You’ll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you’ll feel right at home at Strive!

Benefits & Perks

Hybrid-Remote Flexibility – Work from home while fulfilling in-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits.
Comprehensive Benefits – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts.
Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation with a performance-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources.
Time Off & Leave – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves.
Wellness & Growth – Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend.

To learn more about our offerings, click here
.

What You'll Do

We are seeking a Vice President of Data Platform to lead Strive’s enterprise data platform, data architecture, and data governance capabilities. This leader will carry end-to-end accountability for the design, management, reliability, and evolution of Strive’s data warehouse and for ensuring that high-quality, well-governed data is available to the teams that depend on it.

The role will oversee the ingestion and hydration of the warehouse from a broad range of inbound data streams, including health plan (claims, revenue, benchmarks, adjustment, risk adjustment files), clinical, eligibility, pharmacy, laboratory, Admit, Discharge, Transfer (ADT), partner, and operational data. The Vice President of Data will ensure that data is transformed into trusted, reusable, and well-documented data products for Digital Product, Software Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Medical Economics, Actuarial, Finance, Clinical, and Operations teams.

As a key member of the Technology leadership team, this leader will help establish data as a durable enterprise capability and a strategic foundation for clinical excellence, operational performance, artificial intelligence (AI), and value-based care.

We are looking for a candidate with strong leadership judgment, an entrepreneurial spirit, and excitement for building and scaling a trusted, enterprise data capability in a complex, mission-driven health-tech environment.

Essential Functions

Own the vision, strategy, architecture, operating model, and long-term roadmap for Strive’s enterprise data warehouse and related data platform capabilities.
Carry end-to-end accountability for the routine operation, production support, reliability, and maintenance of warehouse ingestion and hydration across claims, clinical, eligibility, pharmacy, laboratory, ADT, partner electronic health record (EHR), financial, and operational data sources.
Establish scalable ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data-modeling patterns-including batch, incremental, change-data-capture, and streaming approaches-with appropriate attention to latency, cost, resiliency, recoverability, and supportability.
Build and operationalize scalable processes that enable Analytics, Data Science, and Medical Economics teams to develop trusted metrics, reporting, and insights in the data warehouse.
Establish optimization and efficiency practices that keep the warehouse running quickly and reliably for analytical workloads, and implement governance to identify, retire, and document outdated or redundant metrics.
Lead Strive’s standard data governance initiatives and ensure that all teams follow consistent protocols across the warehouse.
Design and operate a production observability and alerting model for ingestion, transformation, warehouse loads, dependencies, and downstream data products, covering freshness, completeness, volume, schema changes, accuracy, reconciliation, latency, availability, pipeline health, and downstream impact to ensure data quality.
Own failed or degraded data-processing incidents from triage through verified closure, including severity assessment, alert routing, escalation, stakeholder communication, recovery, reruns, reprocessing, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and improvements to mean time to detect and mean time to resolve.
Establish and lead a durable data governance and quality-management process, including ownership, stewardship, data contracts, definitions, lineage, access, retention, prioritization, automated validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and issue resolution.
Partner with Digital Product, Software Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Medical Economics, and Actuarial teams to support reliable downstream consumption and production deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of analytical and machine-learning models.
Partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Clinical, and Technology leadership to make governed data available through reliable interfaces, application programming interfaces (APIs), events, and other appropriate consumption patterns while protecting Protected Health Information (PHI).
Lead remediation of recurring data-quality issues and ingestion technical debt, and define operating metrics for freshness, completeness, accuracy, availability, alert quality, incident recurrence, service-level adherence, and request fulfillment.
Recruit, develop, and retain the data organization; establish the right mix of data engineers, data architects, analytics engineers, evaluate and manage vendors, and consultants; and communicate data risks, tradeoffs, priorities, and production health clearly to executive and cross-functional stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, analytics engineering, or a related discipline, including experience building and operating enterprise-scale data platforms.
8+ years of experience leading technical data teams, including responsibility for hiring, developing, managing, and aligning data engineers, architects, analytics engineers, or related technical professionals.
7+ years of experience designing and evolving a data warehouse, lakehouse, or comparable enterprise data platform serving multiple technical, analytical, and business stakeholders.
5+ years of experience owning production operations for data pipelines and warehouse workloads, including monitoring, observability, alert triage, escalation, recovery, reprocessing, incident response, and preventive remediation.
5+ years of experience integrating complex and heterogeneous data sources, including structured, semi-structured, transactional, clinical, claims, or partner data.
5+ years of experience building governed data models, datasets, marts, semantic layers, or other reusable data products for downstream technical and business consumers.
3+ years of experience establishing or operating data governance and data-quality practices, including ownership, stewardship, lineage, documentation, data definitions, access controls, and issue management.
5+ years of experience partnering with Digital Product, Software Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Finance, Actuarial, Medical Economics, Clinical, or Operations teams to deliver trusted data products, reporting, measures, or model inputs.
Internet Connectivity - Min Speeds: 3.8Mbps/3.0Mbps (up/down): Latency Ability to travel and be on-site to meet business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in healthcare, healthtech, health plans, provider organizations, value-based care, or another regulated environment where data quality, privacy, and auditability materially affect business and clinical outcomes.
Experience with healthcare data and interoperability standards, including medical and pharmacy claims, clinical records, lab and ADT data, FHIR,HL7), eligibility, utilization, quality, or risk-adjustment data.
Experience working with modern cloud data platforms, relational and distributed data stores, ELT/ETL) frameworks, orchestration tools, APIs, event streams, and change-data-capture patterns.
Experience improving data freshness through selective use of near-real-time or streaming architectures where the business value justifies the added complexity and cost.
Experience supporting actuarial, medical economics, risk adjustment, quality, financial, or population-health models and reporting.
Experience supporting machine-learning or AI systems through reliable feature pipelines, training datasets, inference inputs, monitoring, and data lineage.
Experience leading data-platform modernization, technical-debt reduction, source-system consolidation, or migration from fragmented legacy data environments.

About You

You communicate clearly and credibly with technical, clinical, operational, and executive audiences, especially when explaining data risk, tradeoffs, incidents, and decisions.
You bring high integrity, dependability, sound judgment, and a strong sense of urgency, accountability, and results orientation.
You are action-oriented and pragmatic, with the ability to translate broad data strategy into achievable steps, operating mechanisms, and measurable improvements while maintaining appropriate review discipline.
You are committed to building a data culture that is rigorous, service-oriented, transparent, and focused on making high-quality data easier to use responsibly.

new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, New York, Lisbon, London

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Director to lead a team of engineers within our Security Products Engineering group. This role will have a strong focus on delivering effective and reliable cybersecurity products and systems. This includes strategy, leadership, technical guidance and building engineering teams. The ideal candidate will have a deep technical background, proven leadership experience, and a passion for developing people and cultivating a strong engineering culture.

This role reports to the VP of Engineering for Security Products and is expected to work with peers to drive results and improvement in alignment with the group’s strategy.

Who you are

A qualified candidate will be equally skilled with people and technology, able to organize and inspire others while participating in technical discussions and planning.

Experience managing engineering managers.
Experience managing complex projects with external dependencies
Results and metrics driven
A strong attention to detail
Great communication skills
Experience hiring great engineers
A kind and generous attitude towards customers and coworkers alike
Ability to set technical direction and own decisions

What you’ll do

Lead multiple teams of engineers delivering customer facing products.
Partner with Product Management to define and execute a strategy and achieve audacious goals.
Lead and mentor engineering managers and engineers across the organization.
Work with peers around the world to drive cross organizational projects and develop best practices.
Foster a culture that is results oriented without sacrificing curiosity, kindness, and empathy for customers and co-workers alike.
Define metrics that guide the engineering teams.
Drive continuous improvement in your teams

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Austin based hires: Estimated annual salary of $300,000 - $380,000
For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $330,000 - $415,000
For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €145,000 - €180,000
For London based hires: Estimated annual salary of £200,000 - £250,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

Medical/Rx Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
Commuter Spending Accounts
Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
Life & Accident Insurance
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

new_jobs.description:
Company Description
Macha PSM provides specialized process safety consulting and engineering services to a wide range of facilities and industries. The team supports clients from small cold storage operations to some of the largest global corporations, offering both consulting and full engineering capabilities. Services include developing innovative PSM programs, leading Compliance Audits and Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs), and supporting EPA and OSHA inspections. The engineering team delivers advanced technical work such as P&ID development, relief vent analysis, inventory calculations, ventilation assessment, and material and energy balance calculations. With offices in Huntsville, Alabama and Moscow, Idaho, Macha PSM is focused on delivering tailored, high-quality solutions to meet the unique safety and engineering needs of each client.
Role Description
The Director of Engineering is a full-time, on-site role based in Huntsville, AL, responsible for leading the engineering organization and ensuring high-quality technical delivery across all projects. This role oversees engineering strategy, resource planning, and project execution, aligning engineering priorities with business and client needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include guiding engineering teams, reviewing and approving technical designs and analyses, and coordinating with project managers and consultants to meet deadlines and quality standards. The Director of Engineering will collaborate with leadership to improve processes, implement best practices, and support integration between software, engineering tools, and process safety methodologies. This role also involves mentoring engineers, supporting recruitment, and fostering a culture of safety, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Qualifications

Professional Engineer license or the ability to obtain a license.
Experience designing ammonia refrigeration systems.
Familiarity with process safety information development (P&IDs, relief system design, material and energy balance, inventory calculations, etc.).
Demonstrated strength in Engineering Management, including overseeing multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Proven Team Leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers, building high-performing teams, and fostering collaboration and accountability.
Background in Software Development or working closely with software teams to support engineering tools, automation, and integration with process safety systems.
Solid Project Management experience, including planning, budgeting, risk management, and delivering engineering work on time and within scope.
Experience with Integration of engineering systems, data, and workflows to streamline operations and improve reliability and insight.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, or related discipline) or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in process safety, industrial facilities, or regulated environments (e.g., EPA, OSHA) is highly beneficial.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex engineering topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work on-site in Huntsville, AL and collaborate effectively across multiple offices and client locations.

Job Description

Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

The Role

Enterprise Digital Operations, a product within Brokerage Recordkeeping Technology, is seeking a Director of Software Engineering who combines deep technical expertise with a strong engineering mindset and a passion for delivering business outcomes. This leader will provide hands-on technical guidance, elevate engineering practices, and coach teams in building scalable, resilient, and high-quality solutions. The ideal candidate will influence the adoption of modern engineering approaches, including AI-enabled development tools, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and effective delivery. As the organization grows, this leader will build and develop a high-performing engineering team capable of scaling enterprise platforms and driving operational excellence.

Primary Responsibilities

Engineering and Delivery

Provide strong technical leadership guiding architectural decisions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical strategy, and enabling teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Drive engineering excellence through mentorship, technical coaching, and the establishment of scalable development practices that improve delivery effectiveness, quality, and operational resilience.
Own engineering delivery for your domain end-to-end: from specification through production, including testing strategy, pipeline design, and operational readiness.
Manage external technical partnerships where your domain is the integration point — own API contracts, integration test harnesses, and ongoing governance as partner platforms evolve.

Standards and Craft

Establish and enforce engineering standards across the platform: contract-first API development, OpenAPI specifications, code review standards, CI/CD pipeline design, and observability practices.
Drive engineering excellence by guiding technical strategy, influencing solution design, and fostering the adoption of proven engineering patterns and practices. Lead the integration of AI-powered tools and streamlined delivery methodologies that accelerate innovation and improve delivery outcomes.
Guide teams in making sound technical decisions by focusing on business impact, challenging conventional thinking, and driving solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, and customer experience.

Team Building and Leadership

Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization by attracting top talent, aligning team capabilities with strategic priorities, and fostering a culture of continuous learning, coaching, and technical excellence.
Partner with the Engineering Leader, architect, and product stakeholders to shape technical direction and represent engineering credibly in senior forums.
Assume accountability for resolving critical delivery and organizational challenges, collaborating across engineering, product, and business teams to accelerate execution and achieve desired outcomes.

Required Expertise

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

Advanced proficiency in Java and Spring Boot for production backend service development.
Strong working knowledge of event-driven and distributed systems: Kafka-based architectures, messaging patterns, microservices, and asynchronous design — sufficient to evaluate architectural decisions, lead technical discussions, and set direction for the team.
Contract-first API development: deep understanding of OpenAPI/Swagger standards, RESTful API design, API lifecycle management, and consumer-driven contract practices.
Cloud-native platform experience: AWS (preferred), container orchestration (Kubernetes), IAM, secrets management, and multi-account operational patterns.
Engineering practice leadership: building and enforcing standards for testing, delivery pipelines, observability (distributed tracing, structured logging, metrics), and code quality.
Experience delivering in regulated industries, financial services, or compliance-driven platforms where accuracy and reliability are non-negotiable.

Preferred

Experience leading a Cloud migration program: replacing or transforming a legacy platform while maintaining production operations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering practices — spec-driven development, code transformation, AI-accelerated delivery — and a track record of driving adoption across a team.
Background in financial services, brokerage technology, or communications-heavy platforms.

How Your Work Impacts The Organization

Enterprise Digital Operations is embarking on a multi-year strategic initiative to bolster the digital experience for our clients and customers by leveraging consistent patterns and adhering to higher security standards to keep the client and technology secure and resilient.

The Team

Fidelity's Brokerage Recordkeeping Technology team designs, develops, implements, and supports applications for our industry leading brokerage platforms. The team focuses on delivering innovative solutions which meet the needs of our customers. Our systems professionals thrive, with a steadfast dedication to innovation, which cultivates a culture of continuous improvement and significant achievement. We see ourselves as a vital link to Fidelity's customers. This is a fast-paced group delivering technology solutions to the complex needs of our clients using distributed and cloud-based technologies. Fidelity will reasonably accommodate associates with disabilities who need adjustments to participate in the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of their job.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. Our Mission and Opportunity

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Brightwheel is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. We are a three-time Cloud 100 company, backed by top investors including Addition, Bessemer, Emerson Collective, Lowercase Capital, Notable Capital, and Mark Cuban.

Our Team

Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

About The Role

Our team is passionate, talented, and deeply customer-focused. We build the platform that thousands of early education programs rely on every day to run their business, serve families, and support children’s growth. As a vertical SaaS company, brightwheel already sits in the middle of all the key workflows in early education: enrollment, billing, staffing, classroom planning, and family communication. We are now extending that foundation into a system of action – where software not only records what happened, but also anticipates work, recommends next steps, and takes safe, automated action on behalf of school leaders, teachers, families, and our internal teams.

We’re looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager who combines strong people leadership, technical judgment, and ownership of measurable outcomes.

In this role, you will lead a team building AI-powered systems for brightwheel’s go-to-market organization. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role: you’ll lead discovery, prototype workflows, and validate them with internal users rather than wait for perfectly defined requirements or dedicated Product and Design support. You’ll work directly with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, and Data to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable products and workflows. The work spans internal products, Salesforce and data integrations, evaluation systems, and customer-facing automation. You’ll use metrics to decide where to invest, stay close enough to architecture and implementation to form an independent view, and step into prototypes or critical-path code when it helps the team move faster.

What You’ll Do

Lead a full-stack engineering team from problem definition through production, measurement, and iteration.
Translate company goals into clear outcomes, investment choices, and a credible execution plan.
Set the engineering strategy for quality, reliability, security, privacy, and operational health.
Ship AI-powered products and change how the team works with AI—not just add AI features.
Hire and develop strong engineers, set a clear bar, and act when the team or an individual is below it.
Make capacity, dependencies, forecasts, and risks visible early.
Work directly with GTM and Operations leaders to identify the real problem, map the workflow, prototype a usable solution, and define how success will be measured before scaling.
Build internal products and AI workflows that improve revenue, conversion, productivity, or quality; measure adoption and results.
Own cross-system execution across Salesforce, data, product, and AI services, with clear dependencies and decision rights.

You may be a good fit if you

Have led an engineering team that delivered measurable customer or business results.
Have the technical depth to challenge architecture, product, data, reliability, and operational decisions without taking the work away from the team.
Have set engineering strategy and made explicit investment and prioritization choices.
Have shipped an AI-powered product or workflow to production and can explain the measurable result.
Have hired and developed strong engineers, built succession, and handled performance issues directly.
Have built trusted partnerships across Product, Design, and business teams while representing a clear Engineering point of view.

Strong candidates may also have

Experience in vertical SaaS, education, fintech, healthcare, CRM, ecommerce, or another operations-heavy domain.
Led a material change in product direction, architecture, or operating model.
Built production AI products, agents, evaluation systems, or automation.
Experience leading engineering for internal business functions and working directly with senior stakeholders.
Strong product intuition and UX empathy; can represent Product and Design for small bets and fast iterations when dedicated support is limited.
Experience connecting CRM, data, integration, and AI systems into reliable workflows that move a business metric.

Technology

Backend: Python with FastAPI and asynchronous workers; React with TypeScript.
Data and systems: PostgreSQL, Redshift, DynamoDB, Airflow, Salesforce, and service integrations.
Cloud: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability.
AI and automation: foundation models, evaluation and orchestration tooling, vector search, and modern AI coding tools.

Director of Broadcast Engineering — Role Overview

Scope of the Broadcast Signal Chain

The role owns the complete broadcast signal chain—from studio cameras, lighting, audio, graphics, production control and master control through satellite, fiber/IP, full-power and low-power television affiliates, OTT platforms and digital streaming endpoints.
The Director leads the Broadcast Engineering team and is accountable for broadcast uptime, audio and video quality, FCC compliance, transmission reliability, disaster recovery, cybersecurity coordination, capital planning, preventive maintenance, vendor management and technology modernization.

Scope of Leadership

Manages a team of Broadcast Engineers (II, III, and possibly Chief Engineer/Lead roles), including hiring, scheduling, performance management, and on-call rotation oversight
Owns capital planning and budget for broadcast infrastructure (cameras, switchers, servers, RF/satellite systems, IT convergence hardware)
Acts as the primary liaison between engineering and production, programming, IT, and executive leadership
Ultimate accountable owner for FCC compliance, uptime, and disaster recovery/business continuity planning
Sets the technology roadmap (e.g., IP-based video migration, cloud playout, automation systems, cybersecurity for broadcast networks)

Live Commerce & Product Presentation

Because Shop LC is a live commerce organization, the Director is also responsible for ensuring that broadcast technology supports the accurate and compelling presentation of jewelry, gemstones, fashion, beauty and home products. This includes camera quality, close-up product imaging, gemstone and metal color accuracy, lighting, audio clarity, graphics integrity, and reliable delivery of the Shop LC signal to customers across every television and digital distribution platform.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic planning: Long-term technology upgrades, vendor/contract negotiation, capital expenditure justification
Team leadership: Hiring, training, mentoring, succession planning for engineering staff
Operational oversight: Ensuring 24/7 broadcast reliability, managing outage escalation and root-cause response
Compliance & risk: FCC regulatory adherence, safety programs (RF exposure, tower/ladder safety, electrical hazards), business continuity/disaster recovery
Cross-functional partnership: Partnering closely with Production, Sales, Merchandising, Programming, Ecommerce, IT, Facilities, Finance and executive leadership to translate technical constraints/capabilities and ensure broadcast infrastructure remains reliable, scalable, secure and capable of supporting future television, streaming and live-commerce growth
Vendor & contract management: Managing relationships with equipment manufacturers, satellite/uplink providers, system integrators
Service levels & monitoring: Establishing measurable service levels, monitoring, escalation procedures and redundancy standards, and maintaining disaster-recovery plans for all mission-critical broadcast systems
Incident response: Leading root-cause analysis and corrective action following significant technical incidents

Qualifications

Experience

Typically 10+ years in broadcast/media engineering, with at least 3–5 years in a supervisory or management capacity
Track record managing teams responsible for live production, master control, or transmission systems
Experience with capital budgeting and vendor negotiation

Technical Depth

Deep knowledge of broadcast systems: RF/satellite, video servers, switching/routing, IP-based workflows, studio automation
Familiarity with IT infrastructure as it intersects with broadcast (networking, cybersecurity, virtualization)
Understanding of FCC regulations and compliance requirements

Certifications (preferred, not always required)

SBE certifications at a senior level (CBRE, CBNT, or similar)
FCC General Radiotelephone Operator License (GROL)
Project management credential (PMP) is a plus given the budget/roadmap responsibilities

Education

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Broadcast Technology, or related field is preferred; equivalent hands-on experience with progressive leadership responsibility is often accepted in lieu of a degree

Leadership / Soft Skills

Proven people management (hiring, coaching, performance reviews, scheduling a 24/7 team)
Strong communication skills for translating technical issues to non-technical executives
Budget ownership and vendor negotiation experience
Change management skills, especially around technology transitions (e.g., SDI to IP)

Video is 90% of the world's data. Most of it is invisible to machines.

TwelveLabs builds the intelligence layer to change that. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government.

We have raised more than $210 million from NEA, Radical Ventures, Amazon, NVIDIA, Snowflake, Databricks, Index Ventures, NAVER Ventures, Korea Investment Partners, Quadrille Capital, Red Bull Ventures, and AI pioneers including Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, and Alexandr Wang.

We are a global company, headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seoul, New York, and London, and employees around the world. We believe the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences make our products stronger. Building technology that understands the world in all its complexity requires people who see it from every angle. We are looking for individuals who are driven by hard problems and want their work to matter. Come build it with us!

About The Role

With our Series B, we are entering our next chapter: building a full-stack video AI company with frontier models at the foundation, an enterprise platform in the middle, and agentic systems that turn raw video into actionable knowledge and insights.

Our customers include some of the world’s leading companies across media, sports, advertising, security, and the public sector. They are asking us to solve increasingly complex problems—not only through our APIs, but by deploying TwelveLabs technology securely and reliably into their environments.

As Director of Engineering, Deployment & Integrations, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for deploying TwelveLabs technology into our customers' and partners’ environments and integrating it deeply into their existing technology ecosystems.

You will own the engineering strategy and execution for customer and distribution partner deployments across hyperscalers, private cloud, on-premise, and other complex enterprise environments. You will work closely with our Engineering and Go to Market teams to turn complex customer requirements into scalable, repeatable deployment and integration capabilities.

This is a highly cross-functional and customer-facing engineering leadership role. You will be equally comfortable working through architecture with a customer's technical team, diving into a complex deployment or integration challenge, and building the systems and processes that allow the next customer to move faster.

Your goal is to make TwelveLabs easy to deploy, easy to integrate, and reliable to operate — while turning the lessons from each customer into capabilities that scale across the business.

In this role, you will focus on the core competencies listed below

Customer Deployment

Own the engineering lifecycle for customer and partner deployments, from technical discovery and architecture through implementation, production launch, and ongoing operations.

new_jobs.title: Deputy Chief Technology Officer, Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
SteerBridge is a modern technology company delivering innovative, mission‑focused solutions to the U.S. Government and private sector.
Leveraging deep expertise in federal acquisition, digital transformation, and emerging technologies, we deliver agile, commercial‑grade capabilities that accelerate operational effectiveness and drive measurable mission success. At the core of SteerBridge is our people—especially the veterans whose leadership, problem‑solving mindset, and commitment to excellence elevate every project we support. We don’t simply hire exceptional talent; we cultivate it
, creating meaningful career pathways for veterans, military spouses, and professionals who share our passion for advancing technology and strengthening the missions we serve.

Position Overview
SteerBridge Strategies is seeking a Deputy Chief Technology Officer (DCTO), Infrastructure to own the cloud architecture, security compliance, corporate network, and IT foundation that underpin SteerBridge's federal technology portfolio. This role sits at the center of the company's technical operations, providing the secure, scalable, and compliant infrastructure that SteerBridge's mission programs, including VA disability claims modernization, aviation readiness analytics, and federal fintech platforms, are built on, as well as the internal IT and security posture of the company itself.

The Deputy CTO, Infrastructure reports to the CTO and works alongside the other Deputy CTOs and Architecture Review Boards to ensure every program inherits a consistent, defensible security and cloud foundation. This person will represent SteerBridge to government security authorizing officials and internal leadership alike, translating infrastructure and compliance decisions into business and mission risk terms.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture Leadership: Direct the design, governance, and continuous improvement of SteerBridge's cloud architecture across all program environments, ensuring consistent standards for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
Security Compliance & Risk Management: Own the security compliance posture of SteerBridge's infrastructure, including RMF/ATO packages, continuous monitoring, and remediation of findings across all programs and corporate systems.
Corporate Network & IT Operations: Lead corporate network architecture and operations, including connectivity, segmentation, identity and access management, and endpoint protection for SteerBridge's internal IT environment.
Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a credible representative of SteerBridge's technical posture to government authorizing officials, auditors, and executive leadership, translating infrastructure and security decisions into mission and business risk terms.
Governance & Standards: Chair or participate in Architecture Review Boards and the Technical Risk Committee, ensuring infrastructure and security decisions across AICES, AIRES, SteerFi, and corporate IT remain aligned and auditable.
Program & People Leadership: Guide and mentor infrastructure, network, and security engineers; build career pathing and technical growth plans in partnership with SteerBridge's Career Ladder framework.
Vendor & Tooling Strategy: Evaluate and manage the vendor and tooling landscape for cloud, network, and security operations, ensuring cost-effective and compliant solutions across the company.
Cross-Program Coordination: Collaborate with program technical leads to identify, capture, and prioritize infrastructure and security requirements ahead of delivery milestones.
Delivery Management: Coordinate planning, sprint execution, and release management for infrastructure and security initiatives, and report progress, risks, and dependencies to executive leadership.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud architecture, or security engineering, including at least 5 years supporting federal or highly regulated environments.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (required). Advanced degree preferred.
Proven ability to design and lead delivery of cloud-native infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting FedRAMP, RMF, and ATO requirements.
Deep understanding of enterprise network architecture, corporate IT operations, identity and access management, and endpoint security.
Strong command of NIST 800-53 controls, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and the federal Authority to Operate lifecycle.
Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional infrastructure, network, and security teams across multiple concurrent programs.
Exceptional communication, documentation, and executive stakeholder engagement skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Active certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
Experience with enterprise vulnerability scanning and compliance tooling (e.g., Tenable.SC/Nessus), SIEM platforms, and Zero Trust architecture.
Experience operating within VA Enterprise Cloud (VAEC), DoD IL4/IL5, or other federal accreditation boundaries.
Background managing security compliance across multiple concurrent ATO packages and program boundaries.
Familiarity with SOC operations, incident response planning, and corporate network segmentation strategy.

Dental insurance
Vision insurance
Life Insurance
401(k) Retirement Plan with matching
Paid Time Off
Paid Federal Holidays

At Goodwin, we work with some of the world’s most successful and innovative investors, entrepreneurs and disruptors in the life sciences, private equity, real estate, technology and financial industries, and where they converge. The Director of Engineering will provide strategic and operational leadership to a high-performing team of engineers and full-stack developers. This role is responsible for driving the technical vision, architectural integrity, and execution of scalable, secure, and production-grade AI-enabled systems. As a key engineering leader, you will bridge the gap between complex business strategy and robust technical execution, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.

What You Will Do

Provide direct, empathetic, and growth-oriented leadership to an expanding engineering organization. Attract, mentor, and retain top-tier talent while fostering a high-accountability, inclusive, and collaborative team culture.
Define the technical roadmap, engineering standards, and architectural blueprints for AI-enabled systems and backend services. Ensure all solutions are scalable, maintainable, resilient, and seamlessly aligned with enterprise architecture.
Oversee the lifecycle design, rapid development, and production deployment of AI-driven applications and full-stack services, ensuring robust integration between modern AI frameworks and core backend infrastructure. Champion rigorous development practices—including advanced CI/CD pipelines, robust automated testing, thorough code reviews, and comprehensive operational readiness—to guarantee the highest standards of code quality and system reliability.
Establish, track, and optimize key engineering metrics (e.g., DORA metrics, system latency, model inference performance, and infrastructure cost efficiency) to drive continuous operational improvement
Supervise agile resource allocation, sprint prioritization, and capacity planning across multiple cross-functional initiatives to balance velocity with engineering health.
Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure all AI system deployments adhere to stringent corporate policies, security protocols, data privacy standards, and evolving regulatory requirements.
Act as a strategic liaison between engineering, product management, and business stakeholders to translate organizational vision into executable technical roadmaps.
Drive internal innovation by spearheading engineering guilds or communities of practice focused on emerging AI paradigms, agentic workflows, and modern backend architectures.
Partner with recruiting to build a highly competitive hiring pipeline, design technical evaluation frameworks, and lead onboarding strategies for incoming engineering talent.

Who You Are

Deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI system architectures, LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector databases, secure API design, and distributed full-stack application development.
A tracking record of scaling engineering teams and developing technical leaders (Managers and Principal/Staff Engineers) within fast-paced environments.
Exceptional ability to translate ambiguous, high-level business requirements into structured, phased, and executable engineering sprints.
Outstanding communication skills, with the proven ability to articulate complex technical architectures to non-technical executive stakeholders and align diverse teams toward a unified technical vision.
Typically requires a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, alongside 8+ years of progressive engineering experience, with 3+ years in a dedicated engineering management or leadership capacity.

new_jobs.title: VP of Engineering (hands-on)
new_jobs.description:
Headways helps enterprises with their AI transformation.
Our Field Deployment Engineers embed inside a customer, capture how the best people actually do the work, and codify it into AI routines that keep running inside the organization, governed, auditable, and measurable. We're deploying at technology and healthcare companies today, with six-figure contracts, a healthy pipeline, and Tim Mayopoulos (former CEO of Fannie Mae) as an advisor.

We're hiring our first engineering leader. If you are someone who is opinionated about how AI-native software gets engineered, wants to own a codebase and is excited to grow a team, please apply.

What you'll own

The codebase and the technical roadmap.
You decide what gets built, how, and in what order. You write code most days. This is not a managing-from-the-side role and won't be for a while.
Product velocity.
Our team shipped a production platform by building with AI-first. Your job is to make that faster and more focused with customer feedback. We'd rather cut scope than cut speed.
Deploying with customers.
You'll be on site and in the room when we deploy: watching how a customer's team actually uses what we built, taking the feedback, and turning it into the next platform change. Nobody here builds blind. The roadmap comes from deployments, and you'll have seen the problem before you fix it.
High-trust deployment.
Our customers hand us their Salesforce, Epic, SharePoint, and Teams data, and some of it is PHI. Security, governance, and data integration are the product, not a checklist.
The engineering team.
You'll hire the first engineers and set how they work. Early on that's one or two people; it grows with the customer base.
"Everyone is a builder."
We want support and FDEs building routines and connectors themselves. Engineering's job is to draw the boundaries: what's safe for non-engineers to build, what needs review, and what stays in the core. You'll design that system.

What's already built

This is a real platform, not a prototype. You inherit:

A TypeScript monorepo (Turborepo, pnpm) running at app.headways.ai: Hono API, React Router 7 product app, DBOS background workflows, an agent runtime with sandbox and egress policies, an ingest service, and connector adapters for the systems our customers run on.
Postgres with Prisma and SpiceDB for the authorization graph.
Production on GCP: GKE with per-service Helm charts, Terraform, Secret Manager, Falco, pgcat, Metabase and dbt for analytics. CI/CD through GitHub Actions with Postgres-backed test runs.
An AI-native development workflow: spec-and-plan docs in the repo, agent-driven implementation, and conventions written for both humans and models.

Some of it is over-built for a team this size, and there's dormant code to retire. Part of the job is deciding what to simplify and what to delete.

Who you are

You've designed and shipped complex enterprise software, and you've been the person who owned the whole system, not one service of it.
You like being in front of customers. Not selling, but watching people use the thing, hearing what's wrong, and fixing it. If you'd rather never leave the editor, this will be a frustrating job.
TypeScript full-stack is your home. You've run Kubernetes in production and can read Terraform well.
You've done real data integration work: connectors, ETL, permissions, the ugly parts.
You take security and governance seriously because you've been on the wrong side of a breach, an audit, or a customer security review.
You've led a small team before, or you've been the obvious person a team followed, and you want to do it properly this time.
You're fine with uncertainty but not looking for a science project. There are paying customers, a working system, and a pipeline. You want to build, see the growth, and lead.

Healthcare or agent-runtime experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Details

Location: San Mateo, CA, in person most days.
Compensation: salary, very meaningful equity, and ownership.
Reports to: Michael Ke Zhang, CEO. You'd work daily with Eric Smejkal, Head of Product, who also ships code.

Let us know your interest

You can quick apply here in Linkedin. But if you want to get serious attention, email mkz@headways.ai with a link to something you built. No cover letter.

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+ employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent's site reliability organization is seeking a hands-on technical manager to lead a globally distributed "Product SRE" team. The platform runs more than 8 million events per year, including live gatherings with over 50,000 attendees. Your team will operate cloud-native infrastructure, build reliability tooling and AI agents, accelerate software delivery for product development teams, and lead the technical onboarding of newly acquired companies. You will run towards the fire, write code alongside your team, raise the bar, and build a team that does the same.

Set the strategy for your team and help shape the overall SRE program for the company
Build partnerships with engineering and platform teams around reliability standards and shared practices
Champion a culture of excellence in site reliability and automation
Lead and technically mentor a team of SREs, writing code, reviewing pull requests, and pairing on hard problems alongside them
Directly manage a team of 5-10 SREs: set clear expectations, run 1:1s, build individualized growth plans, deliver candid feedback, and own hiring and performance decisions
Own the reliability, security posture, and cloud cost efficiency of the infrastructure your team operates
Be on call as the team's escalation point and Incident Commander
Enable partner engineering teams to continuously improve software delivery and developer experience
Partner with product teams to evaluate and strengthen SLI/SLO definitions, translating each product's reliability needs into objectives that are achievable and meaningful
Lead the technical onboarding of acquired companies, integrating their infrastructure, teams, and systems onto Cvent's platform and reliability standards
Foster a culture of learning and technical ownership across the team and its engineering partners
Design, build, and own AI agents and reliability tooling with dedicated budget
Apply AI to your own management work: use it to accelerate QBR prep, KTLO analysis, and routine reporting
Drive AI adoption across the team's full SDLC, from planning and code review to incident response and postmortems
5+ years of experience managing technology professionals
10+ years of overall technology experience
Proven experience running large-scale distributed systems in AWS, including container orchestration (ECS, EKS, Kubernetes); familiarity with Azure or multi-cloud architecture a plus
Deep command of SRE principles and modern platform engineering practices
Excellence in technical team leadership, with a history of developing engineers through pairing, code review, and hands-on mentorship
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code at production scale (AWS CDK preferred; Terraform or equivalent welcome)
Strong hands-on background in automation and CI/CD, with experience building and maintaining pipelines from the ground up
Fluency with modern observability platforms (Datadog or equivalent), including hands-on use of logs, traces, and dashboards and the ability to set team-wide standards for their use
Demonstrated AI fluency: active use of AI coding assistants, LLM-based tooling, or AIOps platforms, with a track record of bringing your team along
Ability to write and review production-quality code (TypeScript or Java preferred; Python, Go, or equivalent welcome); this is a working technical role, not a purely managerial one
Experience managing roadmaps and resource allocations

This position requires strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills; an ability to function in a collaborative and collegial environment; high integrity and intelligence; excellent judgment; a conceptual thinker - strategic as well as pragmatic; and an ability to generate trust and build alliances with co-workers.

Oversight of the security, reliability, and availability of the organization’s information technology environment encompassing networks, hardware, software, telecommunications services, enterprise and utility-specific applications, end-user support services, disaster recovery and ensuring business continuity.

Directing and integrating information technology staff, contractors, and consultants engaged in the support, development, design, implementation, maintenance, and security of wired and wireless networks, telecommunications services, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, utility-related systems, and desktop hardware and software applications deployed throughout the organization.

This position is part of the senior leadership team and is responsible for ensuring that any IT implications associated with other significant initiatives across the organization are appropriately considered and evaluated.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities (essential Functions)

Technology Leadership and Advocacy:

Work with the senior leadership team to set the strategic information technology direction for the utility and the IT team.

Continuously monitor innovation within the field of technology by observing "best of breed" companies, within the water reclamation industry and beyond to advise the best course to take when making technology decisions.

Develop, implement, and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap aligned with LRWRA’s strategic objectives, identifying short- and long-term initiatives for infrastructure, systems, and applications, and clearly identifying operating and capital budget impacts.

Participate in and represent the organization at selected professional associations, user groups, and industry forums as appropriate to organizational needs.

IT Program Management

Responsible for IT department resources including management, coordination, and assistance for all hardware, software, network and other information system related services, projects, programs, and the integration of these activities into the overall LRWRA plan.

Accountable for development and oversight of the IT operating and capital budgets and resource utilization.

Ensure that core hardware, software, and systems required by employees are available, reliable and effective.

Ensure the security and recoverability of LRWRA IT systems, networks and data.

Direct the organization’s efforts to protect networks, systems, applications, and data from cybersecurity threats using risk-based practices appropriate to a municipal utility environment.

Define, monitor, and report on key information technology and cybersecurity performance indicators, and maintain awareness of relevant regulatory, legal, and industry developments affecting municipal and utility technology operations.

Develop, maintain, and periodically test IT disaster recovery and business continuity plans to ensure continuity of critical services.

Coordinate with operational, engineering, and administrative departments to support acquisition, implementation and operation of utility-specific applications, including coordination related to operational technology (OT) and control systems, as applicable, while clearly defining roles and responsibilities to avoid overlap.

Employee Management And Development

Provide strategic and day-to-day leadership and direction to the Information Technology Department, ensuring a high-performance, service-oriented environment aligned with the mission, vision, and values of LRWRA.

Plan, organize, manage, and evaluate the work of the IT Department and, in coordination with peers, develop, implement, and monitor work plans, priorities, and performance measures to achieve organizational goals and objectives.

Create and maintain a culture of customer service that includes effective internal partnerships, practical service delivery, and responsiveness to organizational needs, with awareness of impacts to ratepayers and the public.

Other

Serve as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, contributing technology guidance to organizational planning and decision-making.

Maintain a valid Arkansas driver’s license and the ability to operate company vehicles, as required for travel between facilities or response to critical incidents.

LEVEL OF SUPERVISION RECEIVED

Works with minimal supervision.

Exercises sound, independent judgment in resolving most situations and determining appropriate courses of action, escalating issues based on organizational risk or operational impact.

Responsible for the productivity and performance of the Information Technology Department, providing leadership, coaching, and oversight for approximately five IT staff members, including the Director position.

TOTAL POSITIONS SUPERVISED

Directly supervises two non-director IT staff members and provides indirect supervision and functional leadership to remaining IT personnel.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

Required

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field from an accredited college or university.

Minimum of ten years of progressively responsible information technology experience, including at least five years of supervisory or leadership experience over IT professionals.

Any equivalent combination of education, experience, and certifications that provide the required knowledge, skills, and abilities may be considered.

Demonstrated ability to lead technology services in a small to mid-sized organization, balancing strategic planning with hands-on involvement.

Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize competing initiatives in a resource-constrained environment.

Strong professional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Demonstrated skills in problem solving, conflict resolution, and collaborative decision-making.

Preferred

Licensures, Certifications, and Registrations

Relevant professional certifications related to information security, IT governance, or project management (such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, ITIL, or comparable credentials) are preferred but not required.

new_jobs.title: VP, AI Platform
new_jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, one of the fastest-growing companies in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

The Opportunity

Engine is scaling fast: 1,000+ employees, moving upmarket, and using AI to fuel growth. The proof is already in production: 95.2% of merged production code is AI written, we ship roughly 1,300 pull requests a week (up from 800 a year ago, with fewer engineers), and we have restructured teams from 7 engineers to 5 with a gated path to 3. This is one of the most AI mature engineering organizations anywhere, and it is about to go further.

To do that coherently, Engine is standing up an AI native operating model with three coequal foundations: AI Platform builds the technical rails, Applied AI ships workflow redesign embedded in every domain, and Workforce Transformation updates the operating system. You lead the first.

AI Platform is what everything runs on. Without a single, trusted stack, every team forks its own plumbing and no one can measure or govern what ships. You will not be starting from zero: you inherit a founding team that includes a Principal Architect, a Principal Engineer dedicated to the AI harness, staff level product operations and analytics, and open reqs in flight. As the founding VP, you set the technical strategy, build hands on in the early phase, and scale the org through a Director and principal engineers as adoption proves out. You sit on The Triad with the Senior Director, Applied AI and the Senior Director, Workforce Transformation, prioritizing the enterprise AI roadmap and resolving cross domain calls.

What You'll Own

AI Platform core.
The LLM gateway, agent framework, prompt and agent libraries, and evaluation infrastructure: the rails every Applied AI team and every engineer builds on.
Developer experience and the Velocity program.
The AI harness, coding agents, testing and autonomy frameworks, and the coverage gates that unlock code merging without human review. This group owns Engine's product delivery cycle time number and is the engine that turns 95.2% AI written code into true autonomy. It is the crown jewel of the role.
Product operations, rebuilt as software.
We believe product operations becomes an AI native function. This team builds and runs that software: instrumented cadences, automated reporting, gap analysis, and the PD maturity scorecard. It runs the machinery of the PDLC, not the judgment inside it. An AI Product Ops Lead reports into this role.
Automation engineering and APIs.
Shared APIs, orchestration, and integrations: the rails every automation across Engine uses.
AI data infrastructure.
The AI consumable layer: retrieval and RAG infrastructure, context pipelines for agents and the knowledge base, evaluation datasets, agent memory, and usage telemetry. This layer consumes Engine's data warehouse through governed interfaces; the warehouse, pipelines, and data quality remain with the Data organization.
Observability, security, and cost.
Monitoring, cost controls, and the security posture for platform AI, built in by default and in partnership with Security and IT.
One stack, enterprise wide.
Hold the line on a single shared platform that serves all domains, no forks and no parallel stacks, while meeting the real delivery needs of the Applied AI teams that build on it.
Team.
Grow the platform org as the roadmap proves out: a Director plus principal and staff engineers across agent platform, infrastructure, evaluation, observability, security, and developer experience.

Scope note:
Engine's customer facing AI runtime (Prompt Execution Services and the MCP product layer) is owned by a dedicated AI Systems team inside product engineering, with SLAs and on call. AI Platform integrates with it at a defined interface. This role owns the internal platform, not customer traffic.

What You Bring

Experience.
15+ years in software or platform engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams or orgs and 8+ years building platforms or infrastructure other teams depend on. 3+ years hands on with production AI/ML: direct work with LLMs, agents, and evaluation. Given how new production LLM and agent systems are, we weight depth of shipped work over years in the space.
Platform and infrastructure leadership at scale.
You have built and run shared platforms that many teams depend on, and made the build vs. buy and architecture calls that shaped an engineering org.
Deep AI systems expertise.
Hands on command of LLMs, agents, orchestration, evaluation, and the production realities of AI: latency, cost, reliability, and safety.
Hands on building.
You can personally architect and ship core platform services in the founding phase, not just direct others.
Executive influence and coequal leadership.
You have partnered with executive peers on technical strategy and driven alignment across functions, comfortable owning a lane without absorbing others' mandates.
Engineering leadership.
Proven ability to hire, level, and grow senior engineering talent and set a high craft bar.
Security and responsible AI judgment.
You build security, privacy, and safe use controls into AI infrastructure by default.

Success in the First Six Months

The core rails are live and adopted: LLM gateway, agent framework, and evaluation infrastructure used by the first Applied AI teams and by engineering at large.
The Velocity program has a measured baseline: product delivery cycle time instrumented end to end, with the automated weekly scorecard publishing to leadership without manual effort.
The path to autonomy is open: coverage gates and testing frameworks live in the first pods, with entry criteria agreed for merging well covered code without human review.
The platform is the default way to build AI at Engine, with at least one flagship capability shipped on it and no competing bespoke stacks.
Cost controls and a security posture for platform AI are established with Security and IT.
The Triad operating rhythm is working, and the platform org (Director plus first principal and staff engineers) is growing on plan.

We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.

Compensation

Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range

$336,000—$400,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation

We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

Compensation:
Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
Benefits:
Check out our full list at engine.com/culture
Environments for Success:
Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

About us- Cognex is the largest, most successful and recognized global player in industrial machine vision! We are a financially strong, international company with no debt and have been in business for over 40 years. Using advanced optics, image sensors and artificial intelligence software Cognex vision and ID systems capture an image then analyze it to make sense of what’s being seen. We are deeply committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable work environment, guided by our "Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast" culture, which celebrates employee innovation, determination, and dedication in a dynamic, fun, and distinctive atmosphere .

We are working on a hybrid schedule: 3 days in the office, 2 at home.

Cognex is looking for a Director of Software Engineering to own the strategy, technical direction, and delivery of an Applied AI platform that will re-define how customers configure, manage and optimize industrial automation solutions on factory floors and in logistics operations. This is a highly visible leadership role with a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI-powered industrial automation. This role blends applied R&D, platform engineering, product delivery, and organizational leadership, turning emerging AI research into secure, reliable and scalable production-grade capabilities that create measurable customer value in the demanding realities of industrial manufacturing and logistics operations.

Key Responsibilities

Set the technical vision and multi-year roadmap for a new Applied AI platform to simplify complex, multi-step customer workflows across Cognex’s product portfolio.
Direct applied R&D on emerging AI capabilities, with structured experimentation and prototyping and a clear path from research to production.
Lead architecture decisions spanning embedded devices, edge compute, and cloud services and infrastructure, ensuring seamless experiences across hybrid experiences.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, cost efficiency and operational excellences of the services that power the platform, including APIs, model-serving infrastructure, data pipelines, and connected experiences.
Establish the engineering standards, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and operational practices (SLAs, on-call, incident response) required to deliver trustworthy AI systems in production, balancing capability, reliability, latency, safety, and operating cost.
Partner with Product, R&D, UX, and Hardware organizations to turn ambiguous problems into shipped capabilities, on committed timelines.
Drive adoption of the platform across Cognex's product portfolio, enabling product teams to rapidly build and consume shared AI capabilities and services.
Track the fast-moving AI landscape and translate external advances into pragmatic bets for Cognex.
Drive cost efficiency, observability, and continuous delivery across cloud and hybrid (edge-plus-cloud) deployments, with privacy and security built in.
Grow, lead, and mentor a high-impact engineering organization, building a culture of ownership, technical rigor and execution excellence

Role Requirements

15+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in senior engineering leadership roles managing managers and/or multiple engineering teams, with a proven track record of building high-performing organizations, delivering business-critical products, and driving technical strategy.
Track record of shipping and scaling complex platforms and cloud/online services in production.
Experience leading R&D or applied-research efforts from concept to shipped product
Demonstrated experience turning ambiguous customer problems into shipped products, scalable products and technical strategy
Deep expertise in backend/cloud architecture, API design and platform engineering.
Hands-on familiarity with modern AI application architectures, including LLMOps, agentic systems, tool integration, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol, and evaluation harness design, prompt management, and production observability.
Strong strategic and execution-oriented mindset, with the ability to balance ambitious AI innovation against reliability, scalability, cost, and deployment constraints.
Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align technical teams, executives, customers, and cross-functional partners around a shared vision and execution plan.
Customer-focused leadership approach, with a passion for solving real-world customer problems through innovative software platforms and AI-driven experiences.

Preferred Experience & Qualifications

Computer vision, machine learning inference, or edge/embedded deployment systems.
Background in industrial automation, manufacturing, robotics, or logistics.
Experience productizing AI capabilities at scale, beyond prototypes and proof-of-concepts.
Experience working with developer platforms, APIs, SDKs, or ecosystems that enable other teams to build and innovate more quickly.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field.
